#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""Optional, explicit local AutoDock Vina execution; no asset downloader.

Input is a versioned JSON specification. Only prepared, mapped PDBQT ligands and
standard protein receptors are supported. Scores are predictions, not affinity.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import re
import signal
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import time

MAX_INPUT = 16 * 1024**2
ATOM_TYPES = {'C':'C','A':'C','N':'N','NA':'N','O':'O','OA':'O','S':'S','SA':'S',
              'P':'P','F':'F','Cl':'Cl','Br':'Br','I':'I','H':'H','HD':'H'}
RESIDUES = set('ALA ARG ASN ASP CYS GLN GLU GLY HIS ILE LEU LYS MET PHE PRO SER THR TRP TYR VAL HID HIE HIP CYX'.split())


def digest(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def pairs(items):
    result = {}
    for key, value in items:
        if key in result:
            raise ValueError('Duplicate JSON field: ' + key)
        result[key] = value
    return result


def read_file(path, maximum=MAX_INPUT):
    path = Path(path).expanduser()
    if not stat.S_ISREG(path.lstat().st_mode):
        raise ValueError('Input must be a regular, non-symlink file')
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        raw = stream.read(maximum + 1)
    if len(raw) > maximum:
        raise ValueError('File exceeds explicit byte limit')
    return raw


def load_spec(path):
    return json.loads(read_file(path, 65536), object_pairs_hook=pairs,
                      parse_constant=lambda value: (_ for _ in ()).throw(ValueError('Nonfinite JSON')))


def number(value, low, high, integer=False):
    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)) or not math.isfinite(value):
        raise ValueError('Expected finite numeric setting')
    if integer and not isinstance(value, int):
        raise ValueError('Expected integer setting')
    if not low <= value <= high:
        raise ValueError('Setting outside supported bounds')
    return value


def artifact(record):
    if not isinstance(record, dict) or set(record) != {'path','sha256'}:
        raise ValueError('Artifact requires exactly path and sha256')
    if not isinstance(record['sha256'], str) or not re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', record['sha256']):
        raise ValueError('Explicit SHA256 required')
    raw = read_file(record['path'])
    if digest(raw) != record['sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Input artifact hash mismatch')
    return raw


def parse_atoms(text, receptor=False):
    atoms = {}
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if not line.startswith(('ATOM  ', 'HETATM')):
            continue
        try:
            serial = int(line[6:11]); xyz = [float(line[i:i+8]) for i in (30,38,46)]
            atom_type = line[77:].strip(); charge = float(line[70:76])
        except (ValueError, IndexError) as exc:
            raise ValueError('Malformed PDBQT atom') from exc
        if serial in atoms or serial <= 0 or atom_type not in ATOM_TYPES:
            raise ValueError('Duplicate atom identity or unsupported atom type')
        if not all(math.isfinite(x) and abs(x) < 1e5 for x in xyz) or not math.isfinite(charge):
            raise ValueError('Nonfinite/unbounded molecular coordinate or charge')
        if receptor and line[17:20].strip() not in RESIDUES:
            raise ValueError('Only explicitly supported standard protein receptor residues are accepted')
        atoms[serial] = {'xyz':xyz, 'type':atom_type, 'element':ATOM_TYPES[atom_type], 'charge':charge}
    if not atoms or len(atoms) > (100000 if receptor else 256):
        raise ValueError('Empty or oversized molecule')
    return atoms


def ligand(raw):
    from rdkit import Chem
    text = raw.decode('utf-8'); atoms = parse_atoms(text)
    smiles = [line[len('REMARK SMILES '):] for line in text.splitlines()
              if line.startswith('REMARK SMILES ') and not line.startswith('REMARK SMILES IDX ')]
    if len(smiles) != 1:
        raise ValueError('One explicit ligand SMILES and complete atom map are required')
    mol = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smiles[0])
    if mol is None or len(Chem.GetMolFrags(mol)) != 1 or mol.GetNumHeavyAtoms() > 128:
        raise ValueError('Invalid, disconnected or oversized ligand graph')
    if any(a.GetIsotope() or a.GetSymbol() not in set(ATOM_TYPES.values()) for a in mol.GetAtoms()):
        raise ValueError('Unsupported isotope or ligand element')
    mapping = {}
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if line.startswith('REMARK SMILES IDX '):
            values = [int(x) for x in line.split()[3:]]
            if len(values) % 2:
                raise ValueError('Incomplete ligand atom mapping')
            for index, serial in zip(values[::2], values[1::2]):
                if index in mapping or serial in mapping.values():
                    raise ValueError('Duplicate ligand atom mapping')
                mapping[index] = serial
    heavy = {serial for serial,a in atoms.items() if a['element'] != 'H'}
    if set(mapping) != set(range(1,mol.GetNumAtoms()+1)) or set(mapping.values()) != heavy:
        raise ValueError('Atom mapping does not cover the complete heavy-atom graph')
    for index,serial in mapping.items():
        if mol.GetAtomWithIdx(index-1).GetSymbol() != atoms[serial]['element']:
            raise ValueError('Mapped element mismatch')
    for bond in mol.GetBonds():
        a = atoms[mapping[bond.GetBeginAtomIdx()+1]]['xyz']
        b = atoms[mapping[bond.GetEndAtomIdx()+1]]['xyz']
        if not 0.65 <= math.dist(a,b) <= 2.5:
            raise ValueError('Mapped covalent bond has implausible length')
    return {'smiles':smiles[0], 'canonical':Chem.MolToSmiles(mol, canonical=True, isomericSmiles=True),
            'formal_charge':Chem.GetFormalCharge(mol), 'mapping':mapping, 'atoms':atoms}


def validate(spec):
    required = {'schema_version','engine','receptor','ligand','center','size','seed','cpu',
                'exhaustiveness','num_modes','timeout_seconds','max_output_bytes'}
    if not isinstance(spec, dict) or set(spec) not in (required, required|{'reference'}):
        raise ValueError('Unsupported docking specification fields')
    if type(spec['schema_version']) is not int or spec['schema_version'] != 1:
        raise ValueError('Unsupported docking specification version')
    engine = spec['engine']
    if not isinstance(engine, dict) or set(engine) != {'path','sha256','version'} or engine['version'] != '1.2.7':
        raise ValueError('This route requires explicitly pinned AutoDock Vina1.2.7')

    if digest(binary) != engine['sha256'] or not os.access(engine['path'], os.X_OK):
        raise ValueError('Engine digest/executable check failed')

    ligand_raw = artifact(spec['ligand']); identity = ligand(ligand_raw)
    for field,low,high in [('center',-10000,10000),('size',1,126)]:
        if not isinstance(spec[field], list) or len(spec[field]) != 3:
            raise ValueError('Binding box requires three coordinates and dimensions')
        for value in spec[field]: number(value,low,high)
    for field,low,high in [('seed',0,2147483647),('cpu',1,16),('exhaustiveness',1,64),
                            ('num_modes',1,20),('timeout_seconds',1,3600),('max_output_bytes',1024,64*1024**2)]:
        number(spec[field],low,high,True)
    reference = None
    if 'reference' in spec:
        ref = spec['reference']
        if not isinstance(ref,dict) or set(ref) != {'path','sha256','maximum_rmsd_angstrom'}:
            raise ValueError('Reference needs path/hash and a frozen RMSD threshold')
        number(ref['maximum_rmsd_angstrom'],0.01,20)
        reference = ligand(artifact({k:ref[k] for k in ('path','sha256')}))
        if reference['smiles'] != identity['smiles'] or reference['canonical'] != identity['canonical']:
            raise ValueError('Fixed-map reference requires the same explicit SMILES atom order')
    return receptor,ligand_raw,identity,reference


def identity_signature(item):
    return (item['smiles'],item['canonical'],item['formal_charge'],item['mapping'],
            {k:(a['type'],a['charge']) for k,a in item['atoms'].items()})


def poses(raw, original, spec, reference=None):
    text = raw.decode('utf-8'); blocks=[]; current=None; expected=1
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if line.startswith('MODEL '):
            if current is not None or int(line.split()[1]) != expected:

            if current is None: raise ValueError('Unmatched pose terminator')

        if any(abs(centroid[j]-spec['center'][j])>spec['size'][j]/2 for j in range(3)):
            raise ValueError('Ligand centroid outside declared search box')
        entry={'mode':len(result)+1,'score_kcal_per_mol':values[0],
               'vina_intermode_rmsd_lower':values[1],'vina_intermode_rmsd_upper':values[2],
               'heavy_atoms':len(coords),'centroid_angstrom':centroid}
        if reference is not None:
            distances=[math.dist(item['atoms'][serial]['xyz'],reference['atoms'][reference['mapping'][idx]]['xyz'])**2
                       for idx,serial in item['mapping'].items()]
            entry['reference_rmsd_angstrom']=math.sqrt(sum(distances)/len(distances))
        result.append(entry)
    return result


def bounded_probe(argv, directory, timeout, maximum=65536):
    """Bound version-probe logs while running, preserving them on refusal."""
    stdout,stderr=directory/'version.stdout.log',directory/'version.stderr.log'
    process=None;started=time.monotonic()
    try:
        with stdout.open('xb') as out,stderr.open('xb') as err:
            process=subprocess.Popen(argv,cwd=directory,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=out,stderr=err,
                                     shell=False,start_new_session=os.name=='posix')
            while process.poll() is None:
                if time.monotonic()-started>timeout:raise TimeoutError('Version probe deadline exceeded')
                if stdout.stat().st_size>maximum or stderr.stat().st_size>maximum:
                    raise ValueError('Version probe output limit exceeded')
                time.sleep(0.02)
        return process.returncode,read_file(stdout,maximum)+read_file(stderr,maximum)
    finally:
        if process is not None and process.poll() is None:
            if os.name=='posix':
                try:os.killpg(process.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
                except ProcessLookupError:pass
            else:process.kill()
            process.wait(timeout=10)


def execute(spec_path, output):
    output=Path(output).expanduser().absolute()
    if output.exists() or output.is_symlink() or not output.parent.is_dir():
        raise ValueError('Choose a new output directory under an existing parent')
    output.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    report={'schema_version':1,'status':'failed','passed':False,'scientific_validity':'not_established',
            'network':'No download/upload requested; process networking is not sandboxed',
            'runtime':{'python':platform.python_version(),'platform':platform.platform()},
            'limits':['Prepared standard-protein receptor and mapped ligand only; no chemistry preparation.',
                      'Scores are predictions, not measured binding affinity.',
                      'PDBQT graph declarations/atom mappings and geometry are checked; no electronic validation.',
                      'Trusted local binary; polling bounds can overshoot and are not OS resource isolation.']}
    process=None;started=time.monotonic()
    try:
        spec=load_spec(spec_path); receptor,ligand_raw,identity,reference=validate(spec)
        report.update(spec_sha256=digest(read_file(spec_path,65536)),settings=spec,
                      identity={'canonical_smiles':identity['canonical'],'formal_charge':identity['formal_charge']})
        (output/'receptor.pdbqt').write_bytes(receptor);(output/'ligand.pdbqt').write_bytes(ligand_raw)
        binary=str(Path(spec['engine']['path']).expanduser().resolve())
        probe_code,probe_text=bounded_probe([binary,'--version'],output,min(10,spec['timeout_seconds']))
        if probe_code or b'AutoDock Vina v1.2.7' not in probe_text:
            raise ValueError('Pinned Vina version probe failed')
        argv=[binary,'--receptor','receptor.pdbqt','--ligand','ligand.pdbqt','--out','poses.pdbqt',
              '--seed',str(spec['seed']),'--cpu',str(spec['cpu']),'--exhaustiveness',str(spec['exhaustiveness']),
              '--num_modes',str(spec['num_modes'])]
        for label in ('center','size'):
            for axis,value in zip('xyz',spec[label]):argv.extend(['--'+label+'_'+axis,str(value)])
        report['argv']=argv
        with (output/'stdout.log').open('xb') as out,(output/'stderr.log').open('xb') as err:
            process=subprocess.Popen(argv,cwd=output,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=out,stderr=err,
                                     shell=False,start_new_session=os.name=='posix')
            deadline=time.monotonic()+spec['timeout_seconds']
            while process.poll() is None:
                if time.monotonic()>deadline:raise TimeoutError('Docking engine deadline exceeded')
                if any(p.is_file() and p.stat().st_size>spec['max_output_bytes'] for p in output.iterdir()
                       if p.name not in ('receptor.pdbqt','ligand.pdbqt')):raise ValueError('Engine output/log limit exceeded')
                time.sleep(0.05)
        report['returncode']=process.returncode
        if process.returncode:raise ValueError('Nonzero docking engine exit')
        for name in ('stdout.log','stderr.log'):read_file(output/name,spec['max_output_bytes'])
        raw=read_file(output/'poses.pdbqt',spec['max_output_bytes']);result=poses(raw,identity,spec,reference)
        report.update(status='docked_output_checked',passed=True,poses=result,output_sha256=digest(raw),
                      backend='local_cpu',version_probe=probe_text.decode(errors='replace').strip())
        if reference:
            report['benchmark']={'metric':'heavy_atom_fixed_SMILES_index_RMSD_without_alignment_or_symmetry_minimization',
                                 'reference_sha256':spec['reference']['sha256'],
                                 'threshold_angstrom':spec['reference']['maximum_rmsd_angstrom'],
                                 'first_ranked_pose_passed':result[0]['reference_rmsd_angstrom']<=spec['reference']['maximum_rmsd_angstrom']}
    except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError,TypeError,ImportError,TimeoutError,subprocess.SubprocessError) as exc:
        report.update(error=str(exc),error_type=type(exc).__name__)
    finally:
        if process is not None and process.poll() is None:
            if os.name=='posix':
                try:os.killpg(process.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
                except ProcessLookupError:pass
            else:process.kill()
            process.wait(timeout=10)
        report['elapsed_seconds']=time.monotonic()-started
        report['partial_artifacts_retained']=not report['passed']
        (output/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
    return report


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--spec',required=True);parser.add_argument('--output-dir',required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    try:
        result=execute(args.spec,args.output_dir)
        print(json.dumps({'status':result['status'],'report':str(Path(args.output_dir)/'report.json')}))
        return 0 if result['passed'] else 2
    except (OSError,ValueError) as exc:
        print(json.dumps({'status':'refused','error':str(exc)}));return 2


if __name__=='__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""Original MIT-licensed research record tools; Python standard library only.

Integrity checks establish recorded identity and consistency, never semantic
entailment or scientific correctness. Network access occurs only in explicit
search and lookup-doi commands. Input files and HTTP bodies are capped at 10 MiB.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import csv
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
import re
import sys
import tempfile
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

MAX_BYTES = 10 * 1024 * 1024
CONTEXT = ("run", "condition", "dataset", "metric", "unit", "seed", "statistic", "value")
ACCESS = {"metadata": 0, "abstract": 1, "full_text": 2}


class ToolError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, code: str, message: str):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.code = code


class ToolArgumentParser(argparse.ArgumentParser):
    def error(self, message):
        print(json.dumps({"status": "failed", "error": {"code": "invalid_arguments",
                                                       "message": message}}, sort_keys=True), file=sys.stderr)
        raise SystemExit(2)


def _error(code: str, record: str, detail: str) -> dict:
    return {"code": code, "record": record, "detail": detail}


def _unique_object(pairs):
    result = {}
    for key, value in pairs:
        if key in result:
            raise ToolError("duplicate_json_key", f"Duplicate JSON key: {key}")
        result[key] = value
    return result


def _read_bytes(path: Path) -> bytes:
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        data = stream.read(MAX_BYTES + 1)
    if len(data) > MAX_BYTES:
        raise ToolError("input_too_large", "Input exceeds 10 MiB")
    return data


def read_json(path: str | Path) -> Any:
    try:
        return json.loads(_read_bytes(Path(path)).decode("utf-8"),
                          object_pairs_hook=_unique_object, parse_float=Decimal,
                          parse_constant=lambda value: (_ for _ in ()).throw(
                              ToolError("nonfinite_json", f"Invalid JSON number: {value}")))
    except (ValueError, UnicodeError) as exc:
        raise ToolError("invalid_json", str(exc)) from exc


def write_json(path: str | Path, value: Any, force: bool = False) -> None:
    target = Path(path)
    payload = json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False,
                         allow_nan=False, default=str) + "\n"
    if not force:
        # Exclusive creation also protects against a competing writer.
        with target.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            stream.write(payload)
        return
    descriptor, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".research-record-", dir=target.parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(descriptor, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            stream.write(payload)
        os.replace(temporary, target)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(temporary):
            os.unlink(temporary)


def init_project(directory: str | Path) -> dict:
    root = Path(directory)
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    manifest = root / "research-project.json"
    if manifest.exists():
        return {"status": "preserved", "path": str(manifest)}
    try:
        write_json(manifest, {"schema_version": 1, "target": None, "destination": None,
                              "scope": None, "decisions": [], "budgets": {}, "records": {}})
    except FileExistsError:
        return {"status": "preserved", "path": str(manifest)}
    return {"status": "created", "path": str(manifest)}


def normalize_identifier(value: Any, kind: str | None = None) -> dict:
    """Normalize DOI/arXiv/PMID identity, retaining arXiv version separately."""
    original = value
    result = {"original": original, "kind": kind, "normalized": None, "valid": False}
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
        return {**result, "error": "Identifier must be a nonempty string"}
    text = value.strip()
    if kind:
        kind = kind.lower()
    if not kind:
        if re.match(r"(?i)^(?:doi:|https?://(?:dx\.)?doi\.org/|10\.)", text):
            kind = "doi"
        elif re.match(r"(?i)^(?:arxiv:|https?://(?:www\.)?arxiv\.org/|\d{4}\.\d{4,5}|[a-z-]+(?:\.[a-z-]+)?/\d{7})", text):
            kind = "arxiv"
        elif re.match(r"(?i)^(?:pmid:|https?://pubmed\.ncbi\.nlm\.nih\.gov/|\d+$)", text):
            kind = "pmid"
    result["kind"] = kind
    if kind == "doi":
        text = re.sub(r"(?i)^doi:\s*", "", text)
        if re.match(r"(?i)^https?://(?:dx\.)?doi\.org/", text):
            text = urllib.parse.unquote(urllib.parse.urlsplit(text).path.lstrip("/"))
        text = text.lower()
        if re.fullmatch(r'10\.\d{4,9}/[^\s<>"{}]+', text):
            return {**result, "normalized": text, "valid": True}
    elif kind == "arxiv":
        text = re.sub(r"(?i)^arxiv:\s*", "", text)
        if re.match(r"(?i)^https?://(?:www\.)?arxiv\.org/", text):
            text = urllib.parse.urlsplit(text).path
            text = re.sub(r"^/(?:abs|pdf|html)/", "", text)
        text = re.sub(r"(?i)\.pdf$", "", text).lower()
        match = re.fullmatch(r"(\d{4}\.\d{4,5}|[a-z-]+(?:\.[a-z-]+)?/\d{7})(v[1-9]\d*)?", text)
        if match:
            core = match.group(1)
            # Modern IDs contain a valid calendar month.
            if "." not in core[:5] or 1 <= int(core[2:4]) <= 12:
                return {**result, "normalized": core, "version": match.group(2), "valid": True}
    elif kind == "pmid":
        text = re.sub(r"(?i)^pmid:\s*", "", text)
        if re.match(r"(?i)^https?://pubmed\.ncbi\.nlm\.nih\.gov/", text):
            text = urllib.parse.urlsplit(text).path.strip("/")
        if re.fullmatch(r"\d{1,12}", text) and int(text) > 0:
            return {**result, "normalized": str(int(text)), "valid": True}
    return {**result, "error": "Invalid or unsupported identifier"}


def normalize_records(records: Any) -> dict:
    """Deduplicate by shared canonical identity, retaining every original record."""
    if not isinstance(records, list) or not all(isinstance(r, dict) for r in records):
        raise ToolError("invalid_bibliography", "Bibliography input must be a list of objects")
    groups, errors = [], []
    for index, record in enumerate(records):
        identifiers = []
        for kind in ("doi", "arxiv", "pmid"):
            if kind not in record:
                continue
            values = record[kind] if isinstance(record[kind], list) else [record[kind]]
            for value in values:
                normalized = normalize_identifier(value, kind)
                identifiers.append(normalized)
                if not normalized["valid"]:
                    errors.append(_error("invalid_identifier", str(index), f"Invalid {kind} identifier"))
        if not identifiers:
            errors.append(_error("missing_identifier", str(index), "No DOI, arXiv ID or PMID supplied"))
        keys = {(i["kind"], i["normalized"]) for i in identifiers if i["valid"]}
        matches = [g for g in groups if g["keys"] & keys]
        if matches:
            group = matches[0]
            for other in matches[1:]:
                group["keys"] |= other["keys"]
                group["identifiers"] += other["identifiers"]
                group["provenance"] += other["provenance"]
                groups.remove(other)
        else:
            group = {"keys": set(), "identifiers": [], "provenance": []}
            groups.append(group)
        group["keys"] |= keys
        group["identifiers"] += identifiers
        group["provenance"].append({"input_index": index, "record": record})
    output, conflicts = [], []
    for index, group in enumerate(groups):
        canonical = {kind: sorted(value for k, value in group["keys"] if k == kind)
                     for kind in ("doi", "arxiv", "pmid")}
        for kind, values in canonical.items():
            if len(values) > 1:
                conflicts.append(_error("identity_conflict", str(index), f"Conflicting {kind} identities: {values}"))
        for field in ("title", "year", "authors"):
            variants = {json.dumps(p["record"][field], sort_keys=True, default=str)
                        for p in group["provenance"] if field in p["record"]}
            if len(variants) > 1:
                conflicts.append(_error("metadata_conflict", str(index), f"Different {field} values retained"))
        output.append({"canonical": canonical, "identifier_variants": group["identifiers"],
                       "provenance": sorted(group["provenance"], key=lambda p: p["input_index"])})
    return {"status": "failed" if errors or conflicts else "success", "records": output,
            "errors": errors, "conflicts": conflicts, "semantic_verification": "not_performed"}


def _public_crossref(url: str) -> dict:
    retrieved = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    base = {"request_url": url, "retrieved_at": retrieved, "access": "metadata_only",
            "identity_only": True, "semantic_verification": "not_performed", "results": []}
    request = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "research-writer-evidence-tools/1.0",
                                                   "Accept": "application/json"})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=10) as response:
            data = response.read(MAX_BYTES + 1)
        if len(data) > MAX_BYTES:
            return {**base, "status": "failed", "error": "response_too_large"}
        payload = json.loads(data)
        if not isinstance(payload, dict) or not isinstance(payload.get("message"), dict):
            return {**base, "status": "failed", "error": "invalid_provider_response"}
        message = payload["message"]
        items = message.get("items") if "items" in message else [message]
        if not isinstance(items, list) or not all(isinstance(i, dict) for i in items):
            return {**base, "status": "failed", "error": "invalid_provider_results"}
        results = []
        for item in items:
            normalized = normalize_identifier(item.get("DOI"), "doi")
            if not normalized["valid"]:
                return {**base, "status": "failed", "error": "invalid_provider_record"}
            results.append({"doi": normalized["normalized"], "title": item.get("title", []),
                            "authors": item.get("author", []), "published": item.get("published"),
                            "publisher": item.get("publisher"), "type": item.get("type"),
                            "url": item.get("URL"), "metadata_url": "https://api.crossref.org/works/" +
                            urllib.parse.quote(normalized["normalized"] or "", safe=""),
                            "access": "metadata_only", "retrieved_at": retrieved})
        return {**base, "status": "success" if results else "empty", "results": results}
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        status = "empty" if exc.code == 404 else "unavailable" if exc.code == 429 or exc.code >= 500 else "failed"
        return {**base, "status": status, "error": "http_error", "http_status": exc.code}
    except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, OSError):
        return {**base, "status": "unavailable", "error": "network_unavailable"}
    except (ValueError, UnicodeError, TypeError):
        return {**base, "status": "failed", "error": "invalid_provider_response"}


def search_crossref(query: str, limit: int = 5) -> dict:
    if not isinstance(query, str) or not query.strip() or len(query) > 1000:
        raise ToolError("invalid_query", "Query must contain 1–1000 characters")
    if isinstance(limit, bool) or not isinstance(limit, int) or not 1 <= limit <= 20:
        raise ToolError("invalid_limit", "Limit must be between 1 and 20")
    parameters = urllib.parse.urlencode({"query": query.strip(), "rows": limit})
    return _public_crossref("https://api.crossref.org/works?" + parameters)


def lookup_doi(doi: str) -> dict:
    normalized = normalize_identifier(doi, "doi")
    if not normalized["valid"]:
        raise ToolError("invalid_doi", "DOI is invalid")
    result = _public_crossref("https://api.crossref.org/works/" + urllib.parse.quote(normalized["normalized"], safe=""))
    result["requested_doi"] = normalized["normalized"]
    if result["status"] == "success":
        matches = [r for r in result["results"] if r["doi"] == normalized["normalized"]]
        result["identity_status"] = "identity_verified" if matches else "mismatch"
        if not matches:
            result["status"] = "failed"
            result["error"] = "doi_identity_mismatch"
    else:
        result["identity_status"] = "unresolved"
    return result


def _decimal(value: Any) -> Decimal:
    if isinstance(value, bool) or value is None or isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
        raise ValueError("Value must be a finite decimal number")
    try:
        number = Decimal(str(value))
    except (InvalidOperation, ValueError) as exc:
        raise ValueError("Value must be a finite decimal number") from exc
    if not number.is_finite():
        raise ValueError("Value must be finite")
    return number


def verify_evidence(manifest: Any, base_directory: str | Path = ".") -> dict:
    """Verify hashes and exact context-linked CSV values; no network or writes."""
    errors = []
    report = {"status": "fail", "passed": False, "errors": errors,
              "semantic_entailment": "not_checked", "scientific_validity": "not_checked",
              "scope": "artifact hashes, CSV row/context identity, source access and locators"}
    if not isinstance(manifest, dict):
        errors.append(_error("invalid_manifest", "manifest", "Manifest must be an object"))
        return report
    root = Path(base_directory).resolve()
    indexes = {}
    for category in ("artifacts", "measurements", "claims", "sources", "source_claims"):
        records = manifest.get(category, [])

            errors.append(_error("invalid_records", category, "Expected list"))
            records = []
        index = {}
        for position, record in enumerate(records):
            label = f"{category}[{position}]"
            if not isinstance(record, dict) or not isinstance(record.get("id"), str) or not record["id"].strip():
                errors.append(_error("missing_id", label, "Nonempty string ID required"))
                continue

                continue

    if not indexes["claims"] and not indexes["source_claims"]:
        report["status"] = "not_checked"
        report["reason"] = "no_claims_to_check"
        report["counts"] = {key: len(value) for key, value in indexes.items()}
        return report
    tables = {}
    for identity, artifact in indexes["artifacts"].items():

            if not isinstance(relative, str) or not relative or Path(relative).is_absolute() or ".." in Path(relative).parts:
                raise ToolError("unsafe_artifact_path", "Relative artifact path without traversal required")
            path = (root / relative).resolve()
            if not path.is_relative_to(root):
                raise ToolError("unsafe_artifact_path", "Artifact resolves outside manifest directory")
            expected = artifact.get("sha256")

                raise ToolError("invalid_hash", "SHA-256 hex digest required")

            header = reader.fieldnames or []

    valid_measurements = set()
    def valid_context(record, label):
        good = True
        for key in CONTEXT:

                except ValueError as exc:

                    good = False
            elif not isinstance(record.get(key), str) or not record[key].strip():
                errors.append(_error("missing_context", label, f"Nonempty string required: {key}"))
                good = False
        return good
    def compare(left, right, label):
        good = True
        for key in CONTEXT:
            try:
                same = _decimal(left.get(key)) == _decimal(right.get(key)) if key == "value" else left.get(key) == right.get(key)
            except ValueError:

                errors.append(_error("context_mismatch", label, f"Mismatch in {key}"))

    for identity, measurement in indexes["measurements"].items():
        label = f"measurement:{identity}"
        good = valid_context(measurement, label)
        aid = measurement.get("artifact_id")
        if not isinstance(aid, str) or aid not in indexes["artifacts"]:
            errors.append(_error("missing_artifact", label, "Artifact ID does not resolve"))
            continue
        if aid not in tables:
            errors.append(_error("unverified_artifact", label, "Artifact failed hash or CSV checks"))
            continue
        row = measurement.get("row")
        if isinstance(row, bool) or not isinstance(row, int) or not 1 <= row <= len(tables[aid]):
            errors.append(_error("invalid_row", label, "Row must be a 1-based CSV data-row index"))
            continue
        if compare(measurement, tables[aid][row - 1], label) and good:

    for identity, claim in indexes["claims"].items():

        else:

            if eid not in valid_measurements:
                errors.append(_error("unverified_evidence", label, "Linked measurement failed verification"))
    for identity, source in indexes["sources"].items():
        if not isinstance(source.get("access"), str) or source["access"] not in ACCESS:
            errors.append(_error("invalid_access", f"source:{identity}", "Access must be metadata, abstract or full_text"))
        if not isinstance(source.get("identity_status"), str) or not source["identity_status"].strip():
            errors.append(_error("missing_identity_status", f"source:{identity}", "Identity status required"))
        if not isinstance(source.get("locator"), str) or not source["locator"].strip():
            errors.append(_error("missing_locator", f"source:{identity}", "Source locator required"))
    for identity, claim in indexes["source_claims"].items():
        label = f"source_claim:{identity}"

        source = indexes["sources"].get(sid) if isinstance(sid, str) else None
        if source is None:
            errors.append(_error("missing_source", label, "Source ID does not resolve"))
            continue
        required = claim.get("required_access")
        if not isinstance(required, str) or required not in ACCESS:
            errors.append(_error("invalid_required_access", label, "Required access must be metadata, abstract or full_text"))
        elif not isinstance(source.get("access"), str) or ACCESS.get(source["access"], -1) < ACCESS[required]:
            errors.append(_error("insufficient_source_access", label, "Recorded source access is below claim requirement"))
        if source.get("identity_status") not in ("verified", "identity_verified"):
            errors.append(_error("unverified_source_identity", label, "Source identity has not been verified"))
        for record, name in ((source, "source"), (claim, "claim")):
            if not isinstance(record.get("locator"), str) or not record["locator"].strip():
                errors.append(_error("missing_locator", label, f"{name} requires a source locator"))
    report["counts"] = {key: len(value) for key, value in indexes.items()}
    report["passed"] = not errors
    report["status"] = "pass" if not errors else "fail"
    return report


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    parser = ToolArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    initialize = commands.add_parser("init-project")
    initialize.add_argument("--directory", required=True)
    for command in ("bibliography", "verify-evidence", "search", "lookup-doi"):
        sub = commands.add_parser(command)
        sub.add_argument("--output", required=True)
        sub.add_argument("--force", action="store_true")
        if command in ("bibliography", "verify-evidence"):
            sub.add_argument("--input", required=True)
        if command == "search":
            sub.add_argument("--query", required=True)
            sub.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=5)
        if command == "lookup-doi":
            sub.add_argument("--doi", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        if args.command == "init-project":
            print(json.dumps(init_project(args.directory), sort_keys=True))
            return 0
        if Path(args.output).exists() and not args.force:
            raise ToolError("output_exists", "Output already exists; use --force to replace it")
        if args.command == "bibliography":
            result = normalize_records(read_json(args.input))
        elif args.command == "verify-evidence":
            result = verify_evidence(read_json(args.input), Path(args.input).resolve().parent)
        elif args.command == "search":
            result = search_crossref(args.query, args.limit)
        else:
            result = lookup_doi(args.doi)
        write_json(args.output, result, args.force)
        return 0 if result["status"] in ("success", "empty", "pass") else 2
    except (ToolError, OSError, ValueError, TypeError, RecursionError) as exc:
        print(json.dumps({"status": "failed", "error": {"code": getattr(exc, "code", "io_or_input_error"),
                                                       "message": str(exc)}}, sort_keys=True), file=sys.stderr)
        return 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

            while True:

                buffers[name].extend(chunk[:room])
                if len(chunk) > room:

                        proc.kill()
                    except OSError:
                        pass
                    break

            pipe.close()

               threading.Thread(target=drain, args=(proc.stderr, 'err'), daemon=True)]

    fmt = '{"id":{{json .ID}},"os":{{json .OSType}},"cgroup_version":{{json .CgroupVersion}},"architecture":{{json .Architecture}},"version":{{json .ServerVersion}},"security_options":{{json .SecurityOptions}}}'
    info = decode(docker(p, ['info', '--format', fmt]))
    if info.get('os') != 'linux' or str(info.get('cgroup_version')) != '2' or not isinstance(info.get('id'), str) or not info['id']:
        raise ValueError('Selected engine must be Linux with cgroupv2 and a stable ID')
    if any('rootless' in str(v).lower() for v in info.get('security_options', [])):
        raise ValueError('Rootless engine is not accepted by this tested configuration')
    if p['expected_engine_id'] is not None and p['expected_engine_id'] != info['id']:
        raise ValueError('Pinned engine identity mismatch')
    return info


def inspect_image(p, image_id):
    # Docker 29 omits empty image Config.Volumes; index preserves an explicit null.
    fmt = '{"id":{{json .Id}},"os":{{json .Os}},"architecture":{{json .Architecture}},"volumes":{{json (index .Config "Volumes")}}}'
    image = decode(docker(p, ['image', 'inspect', image_id, '--format', fmt]))
    if (not isinstance(image, dict) or set(image) != {'id', 'os', 'architecture', 'volumes'} or
            image['id'] != image_id or image['os'] != 'linux' or
            not isinstance(image['architecture'], str) or not image['architecture'] or
            not (image['volumes'] is None or isinstance(image['volumes'], dict) and not image['volumes'])):
        raise ValueError('Image identity/OS mismatch or declared writable volumes')
    return image


def staged_paths(state):
    root = Path(state['state_directory'])
    return root / 'runner', root / 'inputs'


def labels(state):
    return {'rw.job_id': state['manifest']['job_id'], 'rw.nonce': state['binding']['nonce'],
            'rw.manifest_sha256': state['binding']['manifest_sha256'],
            'rw.supervisor_sha256': state['binding']['supervisor_sha256']}


def run_arguments(state):
    p, m = state['profile'], state['manifest']
    r = m['resources']; runner, inputs = staged_paths(state)
    args = ['run', '--detach', '--pull=never', '--name', state['container_name'], '--restart=no',
            '--init=false', '--read-only', '--network=none', '--ipc=private', '--cgroupns=private',
            '--cap-drop=ALL', '--cap-add=SETUID', '--cap-add=SETGID', '--cap-add=KILL', '--cap-add=DAC_OVERRIDE',
            '--security-opt=no-new-privileges', '--log-driver=none', '--no-healthcheck', '--user=0:0',
            '--workdir=/work', '--entrypoint', p['container_python'], '--memory', str(r['memory_bytes']),
            '--memory-swap', str(r['memory_bytes']), '--cpus', format(r['cpu_millis'] / 1000, '.3f'),
            '--pids-limit', str(r['pids']), '--shm-size', str(1024**2)]
    for target, size, mode in [('/work', r['work_bytes'], '1777'), ('/tmp', r['tmp_bytes'], '1777'), ('/control', 4 * 1024**2, '0700')]:
        args += ['--tmpfs', f'{target}:rw,nosuid,nodev,size={size},mode={mode},nr_inodes={128 if target == "/control" else 1024}']
    mounts = [(runner, '/runner'), (inputs, '/inputs')]
    mounts += [(runner / name, '/etc/' + name) for name in ('hosts', 'hostname', 'resolv.conf')]
    for source, target in mounts:
        value = str(source)
        if any(x in value for x in (',', '\n', '\r', '\x00')):
            raise ValueError('Bind paths may not contain comma/newline/NUL')
        args += ['--mount', f'type=bind,source={value},target={target},readonly']
    for key, value in labels(state).items():
        args += ['--label', key + '=' + value]
    return args + [m['image_id'], '/runner/linux_supervisor.py', 'run']


def normalize_capabilities(values):
    """Accept Docker's legacy/plain or CAP_ inspect spelling, without extras."""
    if not isinstance(values, list):
        raise ValueError('Capabilities must be an explicit string list')
    normalized = []
    for value in values:
        if not isinstance(value, str) or not re.fullmatch('[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,63}', value):
            raise ValueError('Invalid capability representation')
        name = value[4:] if value.startswith('CAP_') else value
        if not name or name.startswith('CAP_') or name == 'ALL' and value != 'ALL':
            raise ValueError('Invalid repeated/special capability prefix')
        normalized.append(name)
    if len(set(normalized)) != len(normalized):
        raise ValueError('Duplicate capability representation')
    return set(normalized)


def check_container(state, obj):
    p, m, r = state['profile'], state['manifest'], state['manifest']['resources']
    if not re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', obj.get('Id', '')) or state.get('container_id') and obj['Id'] != state['container_id']:
        raise ValueError('Immutable container ID mismatch')
    config, host = obj['Config'], obj['HostConfig']
    if obj.get('Name') != '/' + state['container_name'] or obj.get('Image') != m['image_id'] or config.get('Labels') != labels(state):
        # Image-supplied labels can coexist, but every requested binding must match.
        if obj.get('Name') != '/' + state['container_name'] or obj.get('Image') != m['image_id'] or any(config.get('Labels', {}).get(k) != v for k, v in labels(state).items()):
            raise ValueError('Container name/image/ownership binding mismatch')
    if config.get('User') != '0:0' or config.get('WorkingDir') != '/work' or config.get('Entrypoint') != [p['container_python']] or config.get('Cmd') != ['/runner/linux_supervisor.py', 'run'] or config.get('Volumes') or config.get('Healthcheck', {}).get('Test') != ['NONE']:
        raise ValueError('Container executable/config changed')
    expected = {'ReadonlyRootfs': True, 'NetworkMode': 'none', 'IpcMode': 'private', 'CgroupnsMode': 'private',
                'Memory': r['memory_bytes'], 'MemorySwap': r['memory_bytes'], 'PidsLimit': r['pids'],
                'NanoCpus': r['cpu_millis'] * 1000000, 'ShmSize': 1024**2, 'Privileged': False,
                'PidMode': '', 'AutoRemove': False}
    if any(host.get(k) != v for k, v in expected.items()) or host.get('Init') not in (False, None):
        raise ValueError('Effective isolation configuration changed')
    if host.get('RestartPolicy', {}).get('Name') != 'no' or host.get('LogConfig', {}).get('Type') != 'none' or host.get('Devices') or host.get('DeviceRequests'):
        raise ValueError('Unexpected restart/log/device configuration')
    drop = normalize_capabilities(host.get('CapDrop'))
    added = normalize_capabilities(host.get('CapAdd'))
    if drop != {'ALL'} or added != {'SETUID', 'SETGID', 'KILL', 'DAC_OVERRIDE'}:
        # Only validated bounded capability names enter diagnostics, never env/config.
        raise ValueError('Capabilities changed: add=' + repr(sorted(added)) + ', drop=' + repr(sorted(drop)))
    if set(host.get('SecurityOpt') or []) != {'no-new-privileges'}:
        raise ValueError('Security options changed')
    expected_tmpfs = {target: f'rw,nosuid,nodev,size={size},mode={mode},nr_inodes={128 if target == "/control" else 1024}' for target, size, mode in (
        ('/work', r['work_bytes'], '1777'), ('/tmp', r['tmp_bytes'], '1777'), ('/control', 4 * 1024**2, '0700'))}
    if host.get('Tmpfs') != expected_tmpfs:
        raise ValueError('Temporary filesystem bounds changed')
    runner, inputs = staged_paths(state)
    expected_mounts = {'/runner': str(runner), '/inputs': str(inputs), **{'/etc/' + n: str(runner / n) for n in ('hosts', 'hostname', 'resolv.conf')}}
    observed = {x['Destination']: x for x in obj.get('Mounts', []) if x.get('Type') != 'tmpfs'}
    if set(observed) != set(expected_mounts) or any(observed[d].get('Type') != 'bind' or observed[d].get('RW') is not False or observed[d].get('Source') != source for d, source in expected_mounts.items()):
        raise ValueError('Unexpected writable/mismatched host mount')
    return obj


def inspect_container(state):
    name = state.get('container_id') or state['container_name']
    # Avoid fetching image environment variables or daemon credentials.
    fmt = '{"Id":{{json .Id}},"Image":{{json .Image}},"Name":{{json .Name}},"State":{{json .State}},"Mounts":{{json .Mounts}},"HostConfig":{{json .HostConfig}},"Config":{"Labels":{{json .Config.Labels}},"User":{{json .Config.User}},"WorkingDir":{{json .Config.WorkingDir}},"Entrypoint":{{json .Config.Entrypoint}},"Cmd":{{json .Config.Cmd}},"Volumes":{{json .Config.Volumes}},"Healthcheck":{{json .Config.Healthcheck}}}}'
    raw = docker(state['profile'], ['container', 'inspect', name, '--format', fmt], allow_missing=True)
    if raw is None and state.get('container_id'):
        # A changed/stale saved ID must not hide a differently identified object
        # still occupying the permanently bound name. Reconcile reads only.
        raw = docker(state['profile'], ['container', 'inspect', state['container_name'], '--format', fmt], allow_missing=True)
    return None if raw is None else check_container(state, decode(raw))


@contextmanager
def state_lock(root):
    root = no_symlinks(root)
    if not root.is_dir():
        raise ValueError('Existing prepared state directory required')
    flags = os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT | getattr(os, 'O_NOFOLLOW', 0)
    lock = root / '.lock'
    if lock.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError('Lock symlink forbidden')
    fd = os.open(lock, flags, 0o600)
    stream = os.fdopen(fd, 'r+b')
    acquired = False
    try:
        st = os.fstat(fd)
        now = lock.lstat()
        if lock.is_symlink() or (st.st_dev, st.st_ino) != (now.st_dev, now.st_ino):
            raise ValueError('Lock path identity changed')
        if not stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode) or st.st_nlink != 1 or os.name == 'posix' and st.st_uid != os.getuid():
            raise ValueError('Lock ownership/type changed')
        if st.st_size == 0:
            stream.write(b'0'); stream.flush()
        stream.seek(0)
        try:
            if os.name == 'posix':
                import fcntl
                fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
            elif os.name == 'nt':
                import msvcrt
                msvcrt.locking(fd, msvcrt.LK_NBLCK, 1)
            else:
                raise ValueError('Unsupported client lock platform')
            acquired = True
        except OSError as exc:
            raise ValueError('Another live client owns state; do not replace lock') from exc
        yield root
    finally:
        if acquired:
            if os.name == 'posix':
                import fcntl
                fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_UN)
            else:
                import msvcrt
                stream.seek(0); msvcrt.locking(fd, msvcrt.LK_UNLCK, 1)
        stream.close()


def checked_state(root):
    state = read_json(root / 'state.json')
    state['profile'] = profile(state['profile']); validate_manifest(state['manifest'])
    if state['state_directory'] != str(root) or not re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{32}', state['binding']['nonce']):
        raise ValueError('State location/token changed')
    if digest(canonical(state['manifest'])) != state['binding']['manifest_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('State manifest hash changed')
    runner, inputs = staged_paths(state)
    if state['binding']['supervisor_sha256'] != digest(regular(no_symlinks(runner / 'linux_supervisor.py'), 128 * 1024)) or read_json(runner / 'manifest.json') != state['manifest'] or read_json(runner / 'binding.json') != state['binding']:
        raise ValueError('Prepared controller/manifest/binding changed')
    total = 0
    for entry in state['manifest']['inputs']:
        raw = regular(no_symlinks(inputs / entry['destination']), MAX_FILE)
        total += len(raw)
        if digest(raw) != entry['sha256'] or total > MAX_INPUT:
            raise ValueError('Staged input hash/size changed')
    inspect_engine(state['profile'])
    return state


def prepare(p, manifest_path, state_path, allow_stage=False):
    if not allow_stage:
        raise ValueError('Explicit --allow-stage required for approved files')
    if p['expected_engine_id'] is None:
        raise ValueError('Inspect and pin engine ID before staging')
    engine = inspect_engine(p)
    manifest_path = no_symlinks(manifest_path)
    m = validate_manifest(read_json(manifest_path))
    image = inspect_image(p, m['image_id'])
    # Native architecture only. Docker info uses x86_64/aarch64 on some versions.
    aliases = {'x86_64': 'amd64', 'aarch64': 'arm64'}
    if aliases.get(engine['architecture'], engine['architecture']) != image['architecture']:
        raise ValueError('Image/engine architecture mismatch; emulation is unvalidated')
    root = no_symlinks(state_path)
    if root.exists():
        raise ValueError('State destination must be new')
    if any(c in str(root) for c in (',', '\n', '\r', '\x00')):
        raise ValueError('State bind path contains unsupported delimiter')
    files, total = [], 0
    for entry in m['inputs']:
        source = no_symlinks(manifest_path.parent / entry['source'])
        if not source.is_relative_to(manifest_path.parent):
            raise ValueError('Input escaped manifest directory')
        raw = regular(source, MAX_FILE); total += len(raw)
        if digest(raw) != entry['sha256'] or total > MAX_INPUT:
            raise ValueError('Approved input hash/size mismatch')
        files.append((entry['destination'], raw))
    if total + 65536 > m['resources']['work_bytes']:
        raise ValueError('Work tmpfs has insufficient input headroom')
    root.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    root.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    try:
        runner, inputs = root / 'runner', root / 'inputs'
        runner.mkdir(mode=0o755); inputs.mkdir(mode=0o755)
        code = regular(ROOT / 'linux_supervisor.py', 128 * 1024)
        binding = {'nonce': uuid.uuid4().hex, 'manifest_sha256': digest(canonical(m)), 'supervisor_sha256': digest(code)}
        (runner / 'linux_supervisor.py').write_bytes(code)
        save(runner / 'manifest.json', m, True); save(runner / 'binding.json', binding, True)
        for name, data in [('hosts', b'127.0.0.1 localhost\n::1 localhost\n'), ('hostname', b'research-writer\n'), ('resolv.conf', b'# network disabled\n')]:
            (runner / name).write_bytes(data)
        for name, raw in files:
            target = inputs / name; target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_bytes(raw)
        for folder in (runner, inputs):
            for child in folder.rglob('*'):
                child.chmod(0o555 if child.is_dir() else 0o444)
            folder.chmod(0o555)
        state = {'schema_version': 1, 'profile': p, 'manifest': m, 'binding': binding,
                 'state_directory': str(root), 'container_name': 'rw-' + m['job_id'] + '-' + binding['nonce'],
                 'container_id': None, 'submit_attempted': False, 'status': 'prepared', 'prepared_at': time.time()}
        save(root / 'state.json', state, True)
        return {'schema_version': 1, 'state': 'prepared', 'job_id': m['job_id'], 'engine': engine, 'image': image}
    except Exception:
        # Do not silently delete a partially staged state; it cannot be submitted without complete receipts.
        raise


def receipt(state, operation):
    raw = docker(state['profile'], ['exec', '--user', '0:0', state['container_id'], state['profile']['container_python'], '/runner/linux_supervisor.py', operation])
    result = decode(raw)
    for key, value in [('schema_version', 1), ('job_id', state['manifest']['job_id']),
                       ('nonce', state['binding']['nonce']), ('manifest_sha256', state['binding']['manifest_sha256'])]:
        if result.get(key) != value:
            raise ValueError('Supervisor receipt binding mismatch')
    if result.get('state') == 'artifacts_unavailable':
        if operation != 'status' or set(result) != {'schema_version', 'job_id', 'nonce', 'manifest_sha256', 'state', 'supervisor_fault'}:
            raise ValueError('Invalid supervisor fault receipt envelope')
        if type(result['schema_version']) is not int or result['schema_version'] != 1:
            raise ValueError('Invalid supervisor fault receipt version')
        fault_protocol().validate_fault(result['supervisor_fault'], state['manifest'], state['binding'])
    elif result.get('state') not in TERMINAL | {'running'}:
        raise ValueError('Unknown supervisor state')
    return result


def fault_protocol():
    global _FAULT_PROTOCOL
    if _FAULT_PROTOCOL is None:
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('research_writer_fault_protocol', ROOT / 'linux_supervisor.py')
        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        _FAULT_PROTOCOL = module
    return _FAULT_PROTOCOL


def validate_fault_cache(state, envelope):
    fields = {'schema_version', 'container_id', 'container_name', 'image_id', 'engine_id', 'observed_at', 'capsule'}
    if not isinstance(envelope, dict) or set(envelope) != fields or type(envelope['schema_version']) is not int or envelope['schema_version'] != 1:
        raise ValueError('Invalid supervisor fault cache schema')
    if not isinstance(envelope['container_id'], str) or not re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', envelope['container_id']) or envelope['container_id'] != state.get('container_id'):
        raise ValueError('Supervisor fault cache immutable ID mismatch')
    for key, expected in [('container_name', state['container_name']), ('image_id', state['manifest']['image_id']), ('engine_id', state['profile']['expected_engine_id'])]:
        if envelope[key] != expected:
            raise ValueError('Supervisor fault cache provenance mismatch')
    protocol = fault_protocol()
    if type(envelope['observed_at']) not in (int, float) or not protocol.math.isfinite(envelope['observed_at']) or envelope['observed_at'] < 0:
        raise ValueError('Invalid supervisor fault observation time')
    protocol.validate_fault(envelope['capsule'], state['manifest'], state['binding'])
    if len(canonical(envelope)) > FAULT_CACHE_BYTES:
        raise ValueError('Supervisor fault cache byte cap')
    return envelope


def fault_observation(state, envelope, provenance, cache_error=None):
    result = {'schema_version': 1, 'state': 'artifacts_unavailable', 'job_id': state['manifest']['job_id'],
              'container_id': envelope['container_id'], 'reason': 'Bound supervisor fault; task artifacts are unavailable',
              'supervisor_fault': envelope['capsule'], 'fault_observation': provenance,
              'fault_observed_at': envelope['observed_at'], 'fault_cached': cache_error is None,
              'reexecuted': False}
    if cache_error is not None:
        result['fault_cache_error'] = fault_protocol().error_detail(cache_error, 'receipt_publish')
    return result


def cache_fault(root, state, capsule):
    fault_protocol().validate_fault(capsule, state['manifest'], state['binding'])
    prior = state.get('supervisor_fault_cache')
    if 'supervisor_fault_cache' in state:
        validate_fault_cache(state, prior)
        if canonical(prior['capsule']) != canonical(capsule):
            raise ValueError('Contradictory supervisor fault; first validated capsule is immutable')
        return fault_observation(state, prior, 'current_remote_identical_to_cached')
    envelope = {'schema_version': 1, 'container_id': state['container_id'], 'container_name': state['container_name'],
                'image_id': state['manifest']['image_id'], 'engine_id': state['profile']['expected_engine_id'],
                'observed_at': time.time(), 'capsule': capsule}
    validate_fault_cache(state, envelope)
    updated = {**state, 'supervisor_fault_cache': envelope}
    try:
        save(root / 'state.json', updated)
    except Exception as exc:
        return fault_observation(state, envelope, 'current_remote_cache_write_unverified', exc)
    state['supervisor_fault_cache'] = envelope
    return fault_observation(state, envelope, 'current_remote_cached')


def reconcile(root, state):
    obj = inspect_container(state)
    cached = state.get('supervisor_fault_cache')
    if 'supervisor_fault_cache' in state:
        validate_fault_cache(state, cached)
    if obj is None:
        if cached is not None:
            return {**fault_observation(state, cached, 'historical_cached_container_absent'), 'container_present': False}
        return {'schema_version': 1, 'state': 'uncertain' if state['submit_attempted'] else 'prepared',
                'job_id': state['manifest']['job_id'], 'reason': 'No bound container found; no relaunch performed', 'reexecuted': False}
    if state.get('container_id') != obj['Id']:
        state['container_id'] = obj['Id']; save(root / 'state.json', state)
    if not obj['State'].get('Running'):
        return {**(fault_observation(state, cached, 'historical_cached_container_stopped') if cached is not None else {}),
                'schema_version': 1, 'state': 'artifacts_unavailable', 'job_id': state['manifest']['job_id'],
                'container_id': obj['Id'], 'reason': 'Container stopped/expired; tmpfs artifacts are unavailable',
                'container_exit_code': obj['State'].get('ExitCode'), 'oom_killed': obj['State'].get('OOMKilled'), 'reexecuted': False}
    result = receipt(state, 'status')
    if result.get('state') == 'artifacts_unavailable':
        return cache_fault(root, state, result['supervisor_fault'])
    if cached is not None:
        raise ValueError('Current receipt contradicts an immutable supervisor fault observation')
    return {**result, 'container_id': obj['Id'], 'reexecuted': False}


def rename_new(source, destination):
    """Atomic publication without replacing even an existing empty directory."""
    if os.name == 'nt':
        os.rename(source, destination)
        return
    libc = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
    a, b = os.fsencode(source), os.fsencode(destination)
    if sys.platform == 'linux' and hasattr(libc, 'renameat2'):
        call = libc.renameat2
        call.argtypes = [ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_uint]
        code = call(-100, a, -100, b, 1)  # AT_FDCWD, RENAME_NOREPLACE
    elif sys.platform == 'darwin' and hasattr(libc, 'renamex_np'):
        call = libc.renamex_np
        call.argtypes = [ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_uint]
        code = call(a, b, 4)  # RENAME_EXCL
    else:
        raise ValueError('Atomic no-replace directory publication unavailable')
    if code != 0:
        number = ctypes.get_errno()
        raise OSError(number, os.strerror(number), str(destination))


def collect_files(root, state, result, destination):
    if result.get('state') not in TERMINAL:
        raise ValueError('Only a verified terminal receipt can be collected')
    destination = no_symlinks(destination)
    if destination.exists():
        raise ValueError('Collection destination must be new')
    if destination == root or root in destination.parents or destination in root.parents:
        raise ValueError('Collection must be separate from state')
    m = state['manifest']; artifacts = result.get('artifacts')
    missing = result.get('missing_outputs')
    if not isinstance(artifacts, list) or not isinstance(missing, list) or len(artifacts) > len(m['outputs']) or len(missing) != len(set(missing)):
        raise ValueError('Malformed artifact inventory')
    expected = set(m['outputs']); found = set(); total = 0; decoded = []
    for item in artifacts:
        if not isinstance(item, dict) or set(item) != {'name', 'sha256', 'size', 'data_base64'}:
            raise ValueError('Invalid artifact record')
        name = relative(item['name'])
        if name not in expected or name in found or not isinstance(item['data_base64'], str) or len(item['data_base64']) > 4 * (m['resources']['max_output_bytes'] // 3 + 2):
            raise ValueError('Unexpected/duplicate/oversized artifact')
        raw = base64.b64decode(item['data_base64'], validate=True); total += len(raw)
        if type(item['size']) is not int or item['size'] != len(raw) or digest(raw) != item['sha256'] or total > m['resources']['max_output_bytes']:
            raise ValueError('Artifact hash/size mismatch')
        found.add(name); decoded.append((name, raw))
    if found & set(missing) or found | set(missing) != expected or result['state'] == 'succeeded' and missing:
        raise ValueError('Incomplete/misrepresented artifact inventory')
    logs = result.get('logs')
    if not isinstance(logs, dict) or set(logs) != {'stdout', 'stderr'}:
        raise ValueError('Missing bounded diagnostics')
    for key, item in logs.items():
        if not isinstance(item, dict) or set(item) != {'name', 'sha256', 'size', 'data_base64'} or item['name'] != key + '.log' or not isinstance(item['data_base64'], str) or len(item['data_base64']) > 4 * (m['resources']['max_log_bytes'] // 3 + 2):
            raise ValueError('Malformed log')
        raw = base64.b64decode(item['data_base64'], validate=True)
        if type(item['size']) is not int or len(raw) != item['size'] or len(raw) > m['resources']['max_log_bytes'] or digest(raw) != item['sha256']:
            raise ValueError('Log hash/size mismatch')
        decoded.append(('.logs/' + key + '.log', raw))
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    stage = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='.collection-', dir=destination.parent))
    try:
        for name, raw in decoded:
            path = stage / name; path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            with path.open('xb') as stream:
                stream.write(raw); stream.flush(); os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        summary = {**result, 'partial': result['state'] != 'succeeded' or bool(missing)}
        summary['artifacts'] = [{k: v for k, v in item.items() if k != 'data_base64'} for item in artifacts]
        summary['logs'] = {key: {k: v for k, v in item.items() if k != 'data_base64'} for key, item in logs.items()}
        save(stage / '.collection.json', summary, True)
        # Nonempty stage cannot replace an existing nonempty destination; protect empty dirs too.
        if destination.exists():
            raise ValueError('Destination appeared during collection')
        rename_new(stage, destination); fsync_directory(destination.parent)
        return summary
    finally:
        if stage.exists():
            shutil.rmtree(stage)

            return {'schema_version': 1, 'state': 'removed', 'reexecuted': False}

def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest='operation', required=True)
    for operation in ('inspect', 'prepare', 'submit', 'status', 'recover', 'collect', 'cancel', 'cleanup', 'checkpoint'):
        cmd = commands.add_parser(operation); cmd.add_argument('--report', required=True)
        if operation in ('inspect', 'prepare'):

        if operation == 'prepare':

        if operation == 'submit':

        if operation == 'cancel':
            cmd.add_argument('--allow-cancel', action='store_true')
        if operation == 'cleanup':
            cmd.add_argument('--allow-remove', action='store_true')
        if operation == 'collect':

        if operation == 'checkpoint':
            cmd.add_argument('--store', required=True); cmd.add_argument('--allow-save', action='store_true')

    report = None

            raise ValueError('Report destination must be new')

            result = {'schema_version': 1, 'state': 'inspected', 'engine': inspect_engine(profile(read_json(args.profile)))}
        elif args.operation == 'prepare':
            result = prepare(profile(read_json(args.profile)), args.manifest, args.state, args.allow_stage)
        else:

                             getattr(args, 'allow_cancel', False), getattr(args, 'allow_remove', False),
                             getattr(args, 'destination', None), getattr(args, 'store', None), getattr(args, 'allow_save', False))
        save(report, result, True)
        return 0
    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as exc:
        error = {'schema_version': 1, 'state': 'uncertain', 'error': str(exc)[:1800], 'reexecuted': False}
        try:
            if report is not None and not report.exists() and not report.is_symlink():
                no_symlinks(report)
                save(report, error, True)
        except OSError:
            pass
        print(json.dumps(error), file=sys.stderr)

    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""Bounded public literature retrieval. Retrieval is never semantic verification."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sys
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from datetime import datetime, timezone

MAX_BYTES = 10 * 1024 * 1024
BASES = {'crossref': 'https://api.crossref.org/v1/works',
         'europepmc': 'https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/'}


def now():
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def doi(value):
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        raise ValueError('DOI must be a string')
    value = re.sub(r'(?i)^doi:\s*', '', value.strip())
    if re.match(r'(?i)^https?://(?:dx\.)?doi\.org/', value):
        value = urllib.parse.unquote(urllib.parse.urlsplit(value).path.lstrip('/'))
    if not re.fullmatch(r'10\.\d{4,9}/[^\s<>"{}]+', value):
        raise ValueError('Invalid DOI')
    return value.lower()


def pmcid(value):
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not re.fullmatch(r'PMC[1-9]\d*', value.upper()):
        raise ValueError('PMCID must be PMC followed by a positive integer')
    return value.upper()


def allowed_url(url):
    p = urllib.parse.urlsplit(url)
    return (p.scheme == 'https' and not p.username and not p.password and
            p.port in (None, 443) and
            ((p.hostname == 'api.crossref.org' and (p.path == '/v1/works' or p.path.startswith('/v1/works/'))) or
             (p.hostname == 'www.ebi.ac.uk' and p.path.startswith('/europepmc/webservices/rest/'))))


class RestrictedRedirect(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler):
    def redirect_request(self, req, fp, code, msg, headers, newurl):
        if not allowed_url(newurl) or urllib.parse.urlsplit(req.full_url).hostname != urllib.parse.urlsplit(newurl).hostname:
            raise urllib.error.URLError('Redirect outside fixed provider endpoint blocked')
        return super().redirect_request(req, fp, code, msg, headers, newurl)


def request(url):
    if not allowed_url(url):
        raise ValueError('Only fixed public provider endpoints are permitted')
    receipt = {'url': url, 'retrieved_at': now(), 'timeout_seconds': 10, 'max_bytes': MAX_BYTES}
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'research-writer-literature-tools/0.6.2',
                                               'Accept': 'application/json, application/xml;q=0.9'})
    try:
        opener = urllib.request.build_opener(RestrictedRedirect())
        with opener.open(req, timeout=10) as response:
            raw = response.read(MAX_BYTES + 1)
            receipt['http_status'] = response.status
        if len(raw) > MAX_BYTES:
            return {'status': 'failed', 'error': 'response_too_large', 'receipt': receipt}
        receipt['sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
        return {'status': 'success', 'body': raw, 'receipt': receipt}
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        receipt.update(http_status=exc.code, retry_after=exc.headers.get('Retry-After') if exc.headers else None)
        return {'status': 'unavailable' if exc.code in (404, 429) or exc.code >= 500 else 'failed',
                'error': 'http_error', 'receipt': receipt}
    except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, OSError) as exc:
        return {'status': 'unavailable', 'error': type(exc).__name__, 'receipt': receipt}


def _record(provider, raw):
    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
        raise ValueError('Provider record must be an object')
    if provider == 'crossref':
        identifier = doi(raw.get('DOI'))
        return {'identity': 'doi:' + identifier, 'doi': identifier,
                'title': raw.get('title'), 'version': raw.get('version'),
                'access': 'metadata', 'full_text_retrieved': False,
                'update_to': raw.get('update-to', []), 'relation': raw.get('relation', {}),
                'raw': raw}
    identity, source = raw.get('id'), raw.get('source')
    if not isinstance(identity, str) or not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9._-]+', identity) or not isinstance(source, str) or not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Z][A-Z0-9]*', source):
        raise ValueError('Invalid Europe PMC identity')
    if source == 'MED' and not re.fullmatch(r'[1-9]\d*', identity):
        raise ValueError('Invalid PMID')
    if source == 'PMC':

    normalized_doi = doi(raw['doi']) if raw.get('doi') else None
    if raw.get('pmcid'):
        pmcid(raw['pmcid'])
    return {'identity': 'doi:' + normalized_doi if normalized_doi else source + ':' + identity,
            'doi': normalized_doi, 'source': source, 'id': identity,
            'pmcid': raw.get('pmcid'), 'title': raw.get('title'),
            'version': raw.get('versionNumber'), 'access': 'abstract' if raw.get('abstractText') else 'metadata',
            'full_text_retrieved': False, 'license': raw.get('license'),
            'full_text_links': raw.get('fullTextUrlList'), 'raw': raw}


def search(provider, query, pages=1, page_size=10, filters=None):
    if provider not in BASES or not isinstance(query, str) or not query.strip() or len(query) > 1000:
        raise ValueError('Select crossref/europepmc and a query of 1–1000 characters')
    if isinstance(pages, bool) or not isinstance(pages, int) or not 1 <= pages <= 5 or isinstance(page_size, bool) or not isinstance(page_size, int) or not 1 <= page_size <= 20:
        raise ValueError('Pages must be 1–5 and page-size 1–20')
    if filters is not None and (not isinstance(filters, str) or not filters.strip() or len(filters) > 1000):
        raise ValueError('Filter must be 1–1000 characters')
    if provider == 'europepmc' and filters is not None:
        raise ValueError('Europe PMC filters belong in its explicit query syntax')
    result = {'status': 'empty', 'provider': provider, 'query': query, 'filter': filters,
              'started_at': now(), 'page_limit': pages, 'page_size': page_size,
              'pages': [], 'records': [], 'errors': [], 'coverage': 'bounded search; not field-exhaustive',
              'exhausted': False, 'full_text_retrieved': False, 'semantic_verification': 'not_performed',
              'evidence_families': 'not_assessed; identity deduplication is not study independence'}
    cursor, seen = '*', set()
    groups = {}
    for page in range(1, pages + 1):
        params = {'query': query, 'rows': page_size, 'cursor': cursor} if provider == 'crossref' else {
            'query': query, 'format': 'json', 'resultType': 'core', 'pageSize': page_size, 'cursorMark': cursor}
        if filters:
            params['filter'] = filters
        url = (BASES[provider] if provider == 'crossref' else BASES[provider] + 'search') + '?' + urllib.parse.urlencode(params)
        fetched = request(url)
        receipt = {**fetched['receipt'], 'page': page, 'cursor': cursor, 'status': fetched['status']}
        result['pages'].append(receipt)
        if fetched['status'] != 'success':
            result['errors'].append({'page': page, 'error': fetched.get('error'), 'status': fetched['status']})
            result['status'] = 'partial' if groups else fetched['status']
            break
        try:
            payload = json.loads(fetched['body'])
            if provider == 'crossref':
                message = payload['message']
                items, following = message['items'], message.get('next-cursor')
                result['provider_hit_count'] = message.get('total-results')
            else:
                items, following = payload['resultList']['result'], payload.get('nextCursorMark')
                result['provider_hit_count'] = payload.get('hitCount')
            if not isinstance(items, list) or len(items) > page_size or following is not None and not isinstance(following, str):
                raise ValueError('Malformed provider page/cursor')
            for raw in items:
                record = _record(provider, raw)
                key = record['identity']
                if key not in groups:
                    groups[key] = {**record, 'variants': [], 'provenance': []}
                group = groups[key]
                if raw not in group['variants']:
                    group['variants'].append(raw)
                group['provenance'].append({'page': page, 'provider': provider, 'retrieved_at': receipt['retrieved_at']})
                group['conflicting_variants'] = len(group['variants']) > 1
            if len(items) < page_size or not following:
                result['exhausted'] = True
                result['status'] = 'success' if groups else 'empty'
                break
            if following == cursor or following in seen:
                result['errors'].append({'page': page, 'error': 'repeated_cursor'})
                result['status'] = 'partial' if groups else 'failed'
                break
            seen.add(cursor)
            cursor = following
            result['status'] = 'success' if groups else 'empty'
        except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError) as exc:
            result['errors'].append({'page': page, 'error': 'invalid_provider_response', 'detail': str(exc)})
            result['status'] = 'partial' if groups else 'failed'
            receipt['status'] = 'failed'
            break
    result['records'] = list(groups.values())
    result['next_cursor'] = None if result['exhausted'] else cursor
    result['finished_at'] = now()
    return result


def updates(identifier):
    identifier = doi(identifier)
    fetched = request(BASES['crossref'] + '/' + urllib.parse.quote(identifier, safe=''))
    result = {'status': fetched['status'], 'doi': identifier, 'retrieved_at': now(),
              'lookup_receipt': fetched['receipt'], 'identity_status': 'unresolved',
              'coverage': 'Crossref deposited notices only; absence is not certified',
              'semantic_verification': 'not_performed', 'full_text_retrieved': False}
    if fetched['status'] != 'success':
        result['error'] = fetched.get('error')

    try:

    notices = _updates_search(identifier)
    result['notices'] = notices
    result['status'] = 'success' if notices['status'] in ('success', 'empty') else 'partial'
    return result

    # A DOI query is retained alongside the updates filter, making scope explicit.
    return search('crossref', identifier, 1, 20, 'updates:' + identifier)


def fulltext(identifier):
    identifier = pmcid(identifier)

    result = {'status': fetched['status'], 'pmcid': identifier, 'receipt': fetched['receipt'],
              'access': 'unavailable', 'full_text_retrieved': False, 'read_or_reviewed': False,
              'semantic_verification': 'not_performed', 'identity_status': 'unresolved'}
    if fetched['status'] != 'success':

 'model.safetensors': (31384292, '24c5fa474c48f3b754b86efe752d5f189d2bcd88190fa2270fc92b2ef3034189'),

 'tokenizer_config.json': (95, '7e9161ecdb548ec45a41cbc6b24aa4476fdd418461f491c4207baa99419a29ad'),
 'special_tokens_map.json': (125, '3aedcd4211c0d43aec4e607ff60a63255f3174ead795e997350f09a5f8cd9ee1'),
 'vocab.txt': (93, '0b82cc0a7c7cf9e567b1e5892d793285b9fbae822c964ca48696f7db44598e03'),
 'README.md': (1705, '462a2f24724e19c6be0efab926315c294a863c9a9770e2c8b3d859b2d81a07de')}

def sha(raw):

def read_small(path):

    if len(data) > MAX_BYTES:
        raise ValueError('Input/report exceeds 1 MiB')
    return data

def fasta(raw):
    text = raw.decode('utf-8')
    records, name, seq, seen = [], None, [], set()
    def finish():
        if name is None:
            return
        sequence = ''.join(seq)
        if not 1 <= len(sequence) <= 512 or set(sequence) - AA:
            raise ValueError('Require 1–512 uppercase canonical amino acids; no truncation or residue mapping')
        records.append({'id': name, 'sequence': sequence, 'sequence_sha256': sha(sequence.encode())})
        if len(records) > 16:
            raise ValueError('At most 16 sequences per run')
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        if line.startswith('>'):
            finish()
            name = line[1:].strip()
            if not name or name in seen or len(name) > 256:
                raise ValueError('FASTA IDs must be unique, nonempty and <=256 characters')
            seen.add(name); seq = []
        else:
            if name is None:
                raise ValueError('Sequence before FASTA header')
            seq.append(line.strip())
    finish()
    if not records:
        raise ValueError('No sequences')
    return records


def verify_model(directory):

    if not root.is_dir() or {p.name for p in root.iterdir()} != set(FILES):
        raise ValueError('Model directory must contain exactly the six pinned assets; no unverified sidecars')
    for name, (size, expected) in FILES.items():
        p = root / name
        if p.is_symlink() or not p.is_file() or not p.resolve().is_relative_to(root) or p.stat().st_size != size:
