        if sha(p.read_bytes()) != expected:
            raise ValueError('Model asset hash mismatch: ' + name)
    config = json.loads((root / 'config.json').read_text())
    if config.get('hidden_size') != 320 or config.get('num_hidden_layers') != 6 or config.get('model_type') != 'esm':
        raise ValueError('Unsupported model architecture')
    return root


def allowed_download(url):
    p = urllib.parse.urlsplit(url)
    host = p.hostname or ''
    return p.scheme == 'https' and not p.username and not p.password and p.port in (None, 443) and (
        host == 'huggingface.co' or host.endswith('.huggingface.co') or host.endswith('.hf.co'))


class DownloadRedirect(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler):
    def redirect_request(self, req, fp, code, msg, headers, newurl):
        if not allowed_download(newurl):
            raise ValueError('Model redirect outside approved HTTPS model hosts')
        return super().redirect_request(req, fp, code, msg, headers, newurl)


def prepare_model(directory, allow_download):
    if not allow_download:
        raise ValueError('Explicit --allow-download is required; about 31.4 MB from the pinned public model')
    target = Path(directory)
    if target.exists():
        raise FileExistsError('Model directory exists; preserve it or choose another path')
    if not target.parent.is_dir():
        raise ValueError('Model parent directory must exist')

        staged = Path(temp) / 'model'; staged.mkdir()
        opener = urllib.request.build_opener(DownloadRedirect())
        for name, (size, expected) in FILES.items():
            url = 'https://huggingface.co/' + MODEL + '/resolve/' + REVISION + '/' + name
            request = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'research-writer-protein-tools/0.7.0'})
            with opener.open(request, timeout=30) as response:
                raw = response.read(size + 1)
            if len(raw) != size or sha(raw) != expected:
                raise ValueError('Downloaded asset identity mismatch: ' + name)
            (staged / name).write_bytes(raw)
        verify_model(staged)
        # Reservation is exclusive; a competing target is never replaced.
        target.mkdir()
        try:
            for name in FILES:
                shutil.copyfile(staged / name, target / name)
        except BaseException:
            shutil.rmtree(target)
            raise
    return {'status': 'prepared', 'model': MODEL, 'revision': REVISION,
            'directory': str(target.resolve()), 'downloaded_bytes': sum(x[0] for x in FILES.values()),
            'license': 'MIT model card; package/dependency terms separate', 'inference_executed': False}


def select_device(torch, requested):
    if requested in ('auto', 'cpu'):
        return 'cpu'
    if requested == 'cuda' and torch.cuda.is_available() and not getattr(torch.version, 'hip', None):
        return 'cuda'
    if requested == 'mps' and hasattr(torch.backends, 'mps') and torch.backends.mps.is_available():
        return 'mps'
    raise ValueError('Requested accelerator is unavailable or unsupported; no silent fallback: ' + requested)


def compute(request):
    records = request.get('records')
    if (not isinstance(records, list) or not 1 <= len(records) <= 16 or
            type(request.get('threads')) is not int or not 1 <= request['threads'] <= 8 or
            request.get('device') not in ('auto', 'cpu', 'cuda', 'mps')):
        raise ValueError('Invalid bounded worker request')
    ids = set()
    for record in records:
        if not isinstance(record, dict):
            raise ValueError('Invalid worker sequence record')
        name, sequence = record.get('id'), record.get('sequence')
        if (not isinstance(name, str) or not name.strip() or len(name) > 256 or name in ids or
                not isinstance(sequence, str) or not 1 <= len(sequence) <= 512 or set(sequence) - AA or
                record.get('sequence_sha256') != sha(sequence.encode())):
            raise ValueError('Invalid worker sequence identity/length/chemistry')
        ids.add(name)
    # No remote resolution, custom model code, pickle weights or implicit token.
    os.environ.update(HF_HUB_OFFLINE='1', TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE='1', HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY='1')
    root = verify_model(request['model_dir'])
    import torch
    import transformers
    from transformers import EsmModel, EsmTokenizer
    torch.set_num_threads(request['threads'])
    device = select_device(torch, request['device'])
    tokenizer = EsmTokenizer.from_pretrained(str(root), local_files_only=True, token=False)
    model = EsmModel.from_pretrained(str(root), local_files_only=True, token=False,
                                    use_safetensors=True, trust_remote_code=False, add_pooling_layer=False)
    model.eval(); model.to(device)
    records = []
    with torch.inference_mode():
        for source in request['records']:
            sequence = source['sequence']
            encoded = tokenizer(sequence, return_tensors='pt', truncation=False)
            if encoded['input_ids'].shape[1] != len(sequence) + 2:
                raise ValueError('Tokenizer did not preserve one token per canonical residue plus BOS/EOS')
            encoded = {k: v.to(device) for k, v in encoded.items()}
            states = model(**encoded).last_hidden_state
            pooled = states[0, 1:len(sequence)+1].mean(dim=0).detach().cpu().tolist()
            if len(pooled) != 320 or not all(math.isfinite(x) for x in pooled):
                raise ValueError('Embedding must have 320 finite values')
            records.append({'id': source['id'], 'length': len(sequence),
                            'sequence_sha256': source['sequence_sha256'], 'embedding': pooled})
    return {'records': records, 'dimension': 320, 'device': device,
            'versions': {'python': platform.python_version(), 'torch': torch.__version__,
                         'transformers': transformers.__version__},
            'pooling': 'last hidden layer mean over residues, excluding BOS/EOS; no truncation'}


def validate_result(result, sources):
    records = result.get('records')
    if not isinstance(records, list) or len(records) != len(sources):
        raise ValueError('Worker output count mismatch')
    for actual, expected in zip(records, sources):
        values = actual.get('embedding')
        if any(actual.get(k) != expected[k] for k in ('id', 'sequence_sha256')) or actual.get('length') != len(expected['sequence']):
            raise ValueError('Worker output identity mismatch')
        if not isinstance(values, list) or len(values) != 320 or not all(type(v) in (int, float) and math.isfinite(v) for v in values):
            raise ValueError('Malformed or nonfinite embedding')
    if result.get('device') not in ('cpu', 'cuda', 'mps'):
        raise ValueError('Unknown observed device')


def run_worker(command, directory, timeout):
    log_path, result_path = directory / 'worker.log', directory / 'result.json'
    with log_path.open('xb') as log:
        proc = subprocess.Popen(command, stdout=log, stderr=log,
                                env={**os.environ, 'HF_HUB_OFFLINE': '1', 'TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE': '1',
                                     'HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY': '1', 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE': '1'})
        deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
        try:
            while proc.poll() is None:
                if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                    raise subprocess.TimeoutExpired(command, timeout)
                if log_path.stat().st_size > MAX_BYTES or result_path.exists() and result_path.stat().st_size > MAX_BYTES:
                    raise ValueError('Inference worker exceeded output/log size limit')
                time.sleep(0.05)
            if log_path.stat().st_size > MAX_BYTES:
                raise ValueError('Inference worker exceeded log size limit')
            return proc.returncode
        finally:
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.kill()
            proc.wait()


def embed(args):
    if not 1 <= args.timeout <= 120 or not 1 <= args.threads <= 8:
        raise ValueError('Timeout must be 1–120 seconds and threads 1–8')
    outputs = [Path(args.output), Path(args.embedding_output)]
    if outputs[0].resolve() == outputs[1].resolve() or any(p.exists() for p in outputs):
        raise FileExistsError('Choose distinct new report and embedding paths; existing output is preserved')
    raw = read_small(args.input); sources = fasta(raw)
    root = verify_model(args.model_dir)
    request = {'records': sources, 'model_dir': str(root), 'device': args.device, 'threads': args.threads}
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='esm-embedding-') as temp:
        directory = Path(temp); inp = directory/'request.json'; out = directory/'result.json'
        write_new(inp, request)
        returncode = run_worker([sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).resolve()), '_worker',
                                 '--request', str(inp), '--result', str(out)], directory, args.timeout)
        if returncode:
            detail = (directory/'worker.log').read_bytes()[-3000:].decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
            raise RuntimeError('Inference worker failed: ' + detail)
        result = json.loads(read_small(out)); validate_result(result, sources)
    write_new(args.embedding_output, result)
    artifact = Path(args.embedding_output)
    return {'status': 'computed', 'model': MODEL, 'revision': REVISION,
            'model_weights_sha256': FILES['model.safetensors'][1], 'input_sha256': sha(raw),
            'artifact': {'path': str(artifact.resolve()), 'sha256': sha(artifact.read_bytes())},
            'device_requested': args.device, 'device': result['device'], 'versions': result['versions'],
            'platform': platform.platform(), 'sequences': len(sources), 'dimension': 320,
            'pooling': result['pooling'], 'timeout_seconds': args.timeout, 'threads': args.threads,
            'scientific_validation': 'not_performed',
            'interpretation': 'Protein sequence representation only; not folding, affinity, function or noncanonical chemistry validation.'}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest='command', required=True)
    prepare = sub.add_parser('prepare-model')
    prepare.add_argument('--directory', required=True)
    prepare.add_argument('--allow-download', action='store_true')
    run = sub.add_parser('embed')
    for name in ('input', 'model-dir', 'output', 'embedding-output'):
        run.add_argument('--'+name, required=True)
    run.add_argument('--device', choices=('auto','cpu','cuda','mps'), default='cpu')
    run.add_argument('--threads', type=int, default=1)
    run.add_argument('--timeout', type=int, default=60)
    worker = sub.add_parser('_worker', help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    worker.add_argument('--request', required=True); worker.add_argument('--result', required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        if args.command == '_worker':
            write_new(args.result, compute(json.loads(read_small(args.request))))
            return 0
        result = prepare_model(args.directory, args.allow_download) if args.command == 'prepare-model' else embed(args)
        if args.command == 'embed':
            write_new(args.output, result)
        print(json.dumps(result, allow_nan=False))
        return 0
    except (Exception,) as exc:
        failure = {'status': 'failed', 'executed_successfully': False, 'error': str(exc), 'error_type': type(exc).__name__}
        if args.command == 'embed' and not Path(args.output).exists():
            try: write_new(args.output, failure)
            except OSError: pass
        print(json.dumps(failure), file=sys.stderr)
        return 2


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())

def digest(raw):

def canonical(value):

def pairs(values):

    if len(raw) > maximum:
        raise ValueError('Input exceeds byte limit')

            stream.write(raw)

def text(value, name):
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip() or '\x00' in value or '\n' in value or '\r' in value:
        raise ValueError(name + ' must be a nonempty single-line string')

def relative(value):
    text(value, 'relative path')
    p, w = PurePosixPath(value), PureWindowsPath(value)
    if p.is_absolute() or w.drive or '\\' in value or str(p) != value or any(x in ('..', '.') for x in value.split('/')) or value.endswith('/'):
        raise ValueError('Confined POSIX relative path required')

        raise ValueError('Invalid profile schema or unknown fields; store no credentials')

        raise ValueError('Select an absolute dedicated POSIX remote job root')

def ssh_argv(p):

class TransportError(RuntimeError):

def rpc(p, request):

                if stdout.stat().st_size>MAX_RPC or stderr.stat().st_size>MAX_ERROR:
                    reason='SSH RPC output limit; remote outcome may be uncertain';break

                    except ProcessLookupError:pass

        staged.rename(target);staged=None

    finally:
        if staged is not None:shutil.rmtree(staged)

def main(argv=None):
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    commands=parser.add_subparsers(dest='operation',required=True)
    for op in ('inspect','prepare','submit','status','recover','collect','cancel'):
        cmd=commands.add_parser(op);cmd.add_argument('--profile',required=True);cmd.add_argument('--output',required=True)
        if op=='prepare':cmd.add_argument('--manifest',required=True);cmd.add_argument('--allow-transfer',action='store_true')
        if op!='inspect':cmd.add_argument('--state-dir',required=True)
        if op not in ('inspect','prepare'):cmd.add_argument('--job-id',required=True)
        if op=='submit':cmd.add_argument('--allow-execute',action='store_true')
        if op=='cancel':cmd.add_argument('--allow-cancel',action='store_true')
        if op=='collect':cmd.add_argument('--destination',required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        if Path(args.output).exists() or Path(args.output).is_symlink():raise FileExistsError('Output report exists')
        p=profile(read_json(args.profile))
        if args.operation=='inspect':result=rpc(p,base_request(p,'inspect'))
        elif args.operation=='prepare':result=prepare(p,args.manifest,args.state_dir,args.allow_transfer)
        else:result=operate(p,args.operation,args.job_id,args.state_dir,
                           getattr(args,'allow_execute',False),getattr(args,'allow_cancel',False),getattr(args,'destination',None))
        save(args.output,result,exclusive=True)
        return 0 if result['ok'] else 2
    except (OSError,ValueError,TypeError,KeyError,TransportError,subprocess.SubprocessError) as exc:
        failure={'protocol':1,'ok':False,'status':'failed','error':str(exc)}
        if not Path(args.output).exists() and not Path(args.output).is_symlink():
            try:save(args.output,failure,exclusive=True)
            except OSError:pass
        print(json.dumps(failure),file=sys.stderr)
        return 2


if __name__=='__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())

            return prepare(root, req, ident)
        job = checked_job(root, req)
        if job is None:
            return reply(ident, req, 'not_found')
        if operation in ('status', 'recover'):
            s = snapshot(job)
            if operation == 'recover':
                return reply(ident, req, s['status'], state=s, reconciliation={
                    'mode': 'read_only', 'execution_attempted': (job / 'submission.json').exists(),
                    'restarted': False, 'pid_signal_sent': False,
                    'liveness': 'not_proven_by_heartbeat_or_stored_pid',
                    'next_action': 'Collect terminal artifacts; otherwise reconcile the original job without resubmitting'})
            return reply(ident, req, s['status'], state=s)
        if operation == 'collect':
            s = snapshot(job)
            if s['status'] not in TERMINAL:
                raise ValueError('Only terminal jobs can be collected; uncertain jobs require reconciliation')
            manifest = read_json(job / 'manifest.json')
            if (job / 'artifacts.json').is_symlink():
                raise ValueError('Artifact index symlink is forbidden')
            saved = read_json(job / 'artifacts.json') if (job / 'artifacts.json').exists() else {}
            files, missing, total = [], [], 0
            for name in manifest['outputs']:
                path = inside(job / 'work', name, False)
                if not path.exists():
                    missing.append(name); continue
                path = inside(job / 'work', name)
                with path.open('rb') as stream:
                    raw = stream.read(manifest['resources']['max_output_bytes'] + 1)
                total += len(raw)
                if total > manifest['resources']['max_output_bytes'] or name not in saved or digest(raw) != saved[name]['sha256']:
                    raise ValueError('Output changed, oversized or not checkpointed')
                files.append({'path': name, 'sha256': digest(raw), 'data': base64.b64encode(raw).decode('ascii')})
            if s['status'] == 'succeeded' and missing:
                raise ValueError('Successful-job output is missing')
            logs = {}
            for name in ('stdout.log', 'stderr.log'):
                path = job / name
                if path.is_symlink():
                    raise ValueError('Log symlink is forbidden')
                if path.exists():
                    with path.open('rb') as stream:
                        raw = stream.read(manifest['resources']['max_log_bytes'])
                    logs[name] = {'data': base64.b64encode(raw).decode('ascii'), 'sha256': digest(raw)}
            return reply(ident, req, s['status'], state=s, files=files, missing=missing,
                         partial=s['status'] != 'succeeded' or bool(missing), logs=logs)
        with mutation_lock(job):
            s = snapshot(job)
            if operation == 'cancel':
                if s['status'] in TERMINAL:
                    return reply(ident, req, s['status'], state=s, cancel_requested=False)
                with (job / 'cancel.request').open('a'):
                    pass
                if s['status'] == 'prepared':
                    s = {**s, 'status': 'cancelled', 'reason': 'Cancelled before launch', 'updated_at': time.time()}
                    atomic(job / 'state.json', s)
                return reply(ident, req, s['status'], state=s, cancel_requested=True)
            if (job / 'submission.json').exists():
                return reply(ident, req, s['status'], state=s, already_submitted=True)
            if s['status'] != 'prepared' or (job / 'cancel.request').exists():
                raise ValueError('Job is not prepared for first submission')
            with (job / 'submission.json').open('x', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
                json.dump({'attempted_at': time.time(), 'manifest_sha256': req['manifest_sha256']}, stream)
                stream.flush(); os.fsync(stream.fileno())
            atomic(job / 'state.json', {'status': 'launching', 'updated_at': time.time(), 'heartbeat': time.time(), 'job_id': req['job_id']})
            try:
                with (job / 'controller.log').open('xb') as log:
                    p = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, str(job / 'controller.py'), '--run-job', str(job)],
                                         stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=log, stderr=log,
                                         start_new_session=True, close_fds=True)
                _LOCAL_CONTROLLERS[req['job_id']] = p
                atomic(job / 'controller-receipt.json', {'pid': p.pid, 'purpose': 'diagnostic only; never used for PID-based cancellation'})
            except Exception:
                atomic(job / 'state.json', {'status': 'uncertain', 'updated_at': time.time(), 'reason': 'Launch attempted; operator reconciliation required'})
                raise
            return reply(ident, req, 'launching', state={'status': 'launching', 'job_id': req['job_id']})
    except Exception as exc:
        return {'protocol': PROTOCOL, 'ok': False, 'status': 'failed', 'identity': ident,
                'job_id': req.get('job_id') if isinstance(req, dict) else None,
                'manifest_sha256': req.get('manifest_sha256') if isinstance(req, dict) else None,
                'error': {'code': type(exc).__name__, 'message': str(exc)[:2000]}}


def terminate(child):
    # The controller owns this live Popen handle/group; RPC never trusts a stored PID.
    if child.poll() is None:
        try:
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
        except ProcessLookupError:
            pass
        try:
            child.wait(timeout=1)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            try:
                os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
            except ProcessLookupError:
                pass
            child.wait(timeout=5)


def work_bytes(work):
    total, count = 0, 0
    for directory, dirs, files in os.walk(work, followlinks=False):
        if len(dirs) + len(files) > 256:
            raise ValueError('Work directory entry limit exceeded')
        for name in dirs + files:
            path = Path(directory) / name
            if path.is_symlink():
                raise ValueError('Work directory contains a symlink')
        for name in files:
            count += 1
            if count > 256:
                raise ValueError('Work file count exceeded')
            total += (Path(directory) / name).stat().st_size
    return total


def bound_logs(job, limit):
    """Bound available regular diagnostics without following replaced paths."""
    errors = []
    for name in ('stdout.log', 'stderr.log'):
        path = job / name
        descriptor = None
        try:
            before = path.lstat()
            if not stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) or before.st_uid != os.getuid():
                raise ValueError('Log is not a current-account regular file')
            descriptor = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK)
            actual = os.fstat(descriptor)
            if not stat.S_ISREG(actual.st_mode) or actual.st_uid != os.getuid() or (before.st_dev, before.st_ino) != (actual.st_dev, actual.st_ino):
                raise ValueError('Log identity changed during cleanup')
            if actual.st_size > limit:
                os.ftruncate(descriptor, limit)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            pass  # No task was launched or its diagnostics are unavailable.
        except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
            errors.append(name + ': ' + str(exc)[:200])
        finally:
            if descriptor is not None:
                os.close(descriptor)
    return errors


def run_job(directory):
    job = Path(directory).resolve()
    child = None
    resources = None
    state = {'status': 'failed', 'job_id': job.name, 'updated_at': time.time()}
    artifacts = {}
    try:
        m = validate_manifest(read_json(job / 'manifest.json'))
        prepared = read_json(job / 'prepared.json')
        if digest(canonical(m)) != prepared['manifest_sha256'] or digest((job / 'controller.py').read_bytes()) != prepared['worker_sha256']:
            raise ValueError('Controller/manifest changed before execution')
        resources = m['resources']
        if (job / 'cancel.request').exists():
            state.update(status='cancelled', reason='Cancelled before execution')
        else:
            env = {**os.environ, 'CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES': '', 'OMP_NUM_THREADS': str(resources['threads']),
                   'OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS': str(resources['threads']), 'MKL_NUM_THREADS': str(resources['threads']),
                   'NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS': str(resources['threads']), 'VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS': str(resources['threads'])}
            started = time.monotonic()
            with (job / 'stdout.log').open('xb') as stdout, (job / 'stderr.log').open('xb') as stderr:
                child = subprocess.Popen(m['argv'], cwd=job / 'work', stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                                         stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr, env=env, shell=False,
                                         start_new_session=True, close_fds=True)
                state.update(status='running', heartbeat=time.time(), started_at=time.time())
                atomic(job / 'state.json', state)
                while True:
                    reason = None
                    if (job / 'cancel.request').exists():
                        state['status'], reason = 'cancelled', 'Cancellation request observed by owning controller'
                    elif time.monotonic() - started >= resources['wall_seconds']:
                        state['status'], reason = 'timed_out', 'Wall-time limit exceeded'
                    elif any((job / n).stat().st_size > resources['max_log_bytes'] for n in ('stdout.log', 'stderr.log')):
                        state['status'], reason = 'failed', 'Log-size limit exceeded'
                    elif work_bytes(job / 'work') > prepared['input_bytes'] + resources['max_output_bytes']:
                        state['status'], reason = 'failed', 'Work/output-size limit exceeded'
                    if reason:
                        state['reason'] = reason; terminate(child); break
                    if child.poll() is not None:
                        state['returncode'] = child.returncode
                        state['status'] = 'succeeded' if child.returncode == 0 else 'failed'
                        if child.returncode:
                            state['reason'] = 'Task exited nonzero'
                        break
                    state['heartbeat'] = time.time(); atomic(job / 'state.json', state); time.sleep(0.1)
                state['returncode'] = child.wait()
            total = 0
            for name in m['outputs']:
                path = inside(job / 'work', name, False)
                if not path.exists():
                    if state['status'] == 'succeeded':
                        state.update(status='failed', reason='Declared output missing')
                    continue
                path = inside(job / 'work', name)
                with path.open('rb') as stream:
                    raw = stream.read(resources['max_output_bytes'] + 1)
                total += len(raw)
                if total > resources['max_output_bytes']:
                    state.update(status='failed', reason='Declared output-size limit exceeded')
                    artifacts = {}; break
                artifacts[name] = {'sha256': digest(raw), 'bytes': len(raw)}
    except Exception as exc:
        if child is not None:
            terminate(child)
        state.update(status='failed', reason=f'{type(exc).__name__}: {str(exc)[:1000]}')
    finally:
        # Artifact validation can fail after a task has emitted diagnostics.
        # Stop the owned child first, then bound logs on every terminal path.
        if child is not None:
            try:
                terminate(child)
            except Exception as exc:
                state.update(status='failed', reason='Owned child cleanup failed: ' + str(exc)[:500])
        if resources is not None:
            cleanup_errors = bound_logs(job, resources['max_log_bytes'])
            if cleanup_errors:
                state['log_cleanup_errors'] = cleanup_errors
                if state['status'] == 'succeeded':
                    state.update(status='failed', reason='Available diagnostic cleanup failed')
        state.update(updated_at=time.time(), finished_at=time.time())
        atomic(job / 'artifacts.json', artifacts)
        atomic(job / 'state.json', state)
    return 0


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--run-job', help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.run_job:
        return run_job(args.run_job)
    try:
        request = parse(sys.stdin.buffer.read(MAX_REQUEST + 1))
        result = handle(request)
    except Exception as exc:
        result = {'protocol': PROTOCOL, 'ok': False, 'status': 'failed', 'error': {'code': type(exc).__name__, 'message': str(exc)[:2000]}}
    raw = canonical(result) + b'\n'
    if len(raw) > MAX_REQUEST:
        raw = canonical({'protocol': PROTOCOL, 'ok': False, 'status': 'failed', 'error': {'code': 'response_limit', 'message': 'Response exceeds limit'}}) + b'\n'
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(raw)
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())

def read_bytes(path):
    p = Path(path)
    if not p.is_file() or p.stat().st_size > MAX_INPUT:
        raise ValueError('Input must be a regular file no larger than 10 MiB')
    return p.read_bytes()


def read_json(path):

def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def write_json(path, value, force=False):
    p = Path(path)

    text = json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + '\n'
    with p.open('w' if force else 'x', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(text)


def profile(path):
    p = {'schema_version': 1, 'mode': 'local', 'python': None,
         'remote_host': None, 'accelerator': 'unknown',
         'executables': {}, 'model_dirs': {}, 'notes': ''}
    if path:
        given = read_json(path)
        if not isinstance(given, dict) or set(given) - set(p):
            raise ValueError('Profile contains unknown fields; store no credentials or readiness claims')
        p.update(given)
    if p['schema_version'] != 1 or p['mode'] not in ('local', 'remote'):
        raise ValueError('Unsupported profile schema or mode')
    if p['accelerator'] not in ('auto', 'unknown', 'cpu', 'cuda', 'mps', 'rocm'):
        raise ValueError('Unsupported accelerator declaration')
    for key in ('executables', 'model_dirs'):
        if not isinstance(p[key], dict) or not all(isinstance(k, str) and isinstance(v, str) and v for k, v in p[key].items()):
            raise ValueError(key + ' must map engine IDs to nonempty paths')
    for key in ('python', 'remote_host'):
        if p[key] is not None and (not isinstance(p[key], str) or not p[key]):

def rdkit_base(args):

def openmm_smoke(args):
    import openmm
    from openmm import unit
    system = openmm.System()
    system.addParticle(12 * unit.dalton)
    system.addParticle(12 * unit.dalton)
    force = openmm.HarmonicBondForce()
    force.addBond(0, 1, 0.1 * unit.nanometer, 100 * unit.kilojoule_per_mole / unit.nanometer**2)
    system.addForce(force)
    integrator = openmm.VerletIntegrator(0.001 * unit.picosecond)
    context = openmm.Context(system, integrator, openmm.Platform.getPlatformByName('Reference'))
    context.setPositions([openmm.Vec3(0, 0, 0), openmm.Vec3(0.2, 0, 0)] * unit.nanometer)
    value = context.getState(getEnergy=True).getPotentialEnergy().value_in_unit(unit.kilojoule_per_mole)
    observed = context.getPlatform().getName()
    if not math.isfinite(value) or not math.isclose(value, 0.5, rel_tol=0, abs_tol=1e-8) or observed != 'Reference':
        raise ValueError('Analytic energy or Reference platform acceptance failed')
    return {'status': 'computed', 'kind': 'artificial_two_particle_energy_check', 'energy': value,
            'unit': 'kJ/mol', 'expected': 0.5, 'error': value - 0.5, 'platform': observed,
            'interpretation': 'Installation/unit smoke test only; no biological simulation or validation performed.',
            'provenance': provenance('OpenMM', {'openmm': openmm.__version__}, {},

        nonstandard = [{'position_1based': i + 1, 'symbol': c} for i, c in enumerate(sequence) if c not in 'ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY']
        records.append({'id': current, 'length': len(sequence), 'sequence_sha256': digest(sequence.encode()),
                        'nonstandard_count': len(nonstandard), 'first_nonstandard_positions': nonstandard[:100],
                        'canonical_sequence_only': not nonstandard})
    for line in raw.decode('utf-8').splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        if line.startswith('>'):
            append()
            current = line[1:].strip()
            if not current or current in seen:
                raise ValueError('Missing or duplicate FASTA identifier')
            seen.add(current)
            seq = []
        else:
            if current is None:
                raise ValueError('FASTA sequence before header')
            seq.append(''.join(line.split()))
    append()
    if not records:
        raise ValueError('No FASTA records')
    return {'status': 'inspected', 'input_sha256': digest(raw), 'records': records,
            'interpretation': 'Syntax/identity check only. Residue symbols, including U/O/X, do not establish model support for chemical modifications or cofactors.'}


def measurements(args, result):
    if args.command == 'rdkit-descriptors':
        metrics = result['descriptors']
        units = result['units']
        condition, seed = result['canonical_smiles'], 'not_applicable'
    elif args.command == 'openmm-smoke':
        metrics, units = {'potential_energy': result['energy']}, {'potential_energy': result['unit']}
        condition, seed = 'two_particle_harmonic_reference', 'not_applicable'
    else:
        return
    output = Path(args.output).with_suffix('.measurements.csv')
    if output.resolve() == Path(args.output).resolve():
        raise ValueError('JSON output must not end in .measurements.csv')
    stream = io.StringIO(newline='')
    writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=CONTEXT, lineterminator='\n')
    writer.writeheader()
    for name, value in metrics.items():
        writer.writerow({'run': args.run_id or args.command, 'condition': condition, 'dataset': 'explicit_local_input',
                         'metric': name, 'unit': units.get(name, 'count' if isinstance(value, int) else 'dimensionless'),
                         'seed': seed, 'statistic': 'single_deterministic_calculation', 'value': value})
    data = stream.getvalue().encode()
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with output.open('wb' if args.force else 'xb') as f:
        f.write(data)
    result['measurement_artifact'] = {'path': str(output.resolve()), 'sha256': digest(data), 'columns': CONTEXT}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    subs = parser.add_subparsers(dest='command', required=True)
    for name in ('doctor', 'profile', 'plan', 'rdkit-descriptors', 'rdkit-conformer', 'openmm-smoke', 'fasta'):
        sub = subs.add_parser(name)
        sub.add_argument('--output', required=True, help='New JSON report; existing files preserved unless --force')
        sub.add_argument('--force', action='store_true')
        if name in ('doctor', 'plan'):
            sub.add_argument('--profile')
        if name == 'doctor':
            sub.add_argument('--probe-gpu', action='store_true')
        if name in ('plan', 'fasta'):
            sub.add_argument('--input', required=True)
        if name == 'plan':
            sub.add_argument('--tool', required=True)
        if name.startswith('rdkit-'):
            sub.add_argument('--smiles', required=True)
        if name == 'rdkit-conformer':
            sub.add_argument('--sdf', required=True)
            sub.add_argument('--seed', type=int, required=True)
            sub.add_argument('--max-iters', type=int, default=200)
        if name in ('rdkit-descriptors', 'openmm-smoke'):
            sub.add_argument('--run-id')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        outputs = [Path(args.output)]
        if args.command == 'rdkit-conformer':
            outputs.append(Path(args.sdf))
        if args.command in ('rdkit-descriptors', 'openmm-smoke'):
            outputs.append(Path(args.output).with_suffix('.measurements.csv'))
        if len({p.resolve() for p in outputs}) != len(outputs):
            raise ValueError('Report, SDF and measurement output paths must be distinct')
        if any(p.exists() for p in outputs) and not args.force:
            raise FileExistsError('An output exists; choose new paths or explicitly use --force')
        if args.command == 'profile':
            result = profile(None)
        else:
            function = {'doctor': doctor, 'plan': plan, 'rdkit-descriptors': descriptors,
                        'rdkit-conformer': conformer, 'openmm-smoke': openmm_smoke, 'fasta': fasta}[args.command]
            result = function(args)
            measurements(args, result)
        write_json(args.output, result, args.force)
        print(json.dumps({'status': result.get('status', 'profile_created'), 'output': args.output}, allow_nan=False))
        return 2 if result.get('status') == 'not_converged' else 0
    except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, OSError, ImportError, RuntimeError) as err:
        failure = {'status': 'unavailable' if isinstance(err, ImportError) else 'failed',
                   'error': str(err), 'error_type': type(err).__name__, 'executed_successfully': False}
        if not Path(args.output).exists():
            try:
                write_json(args.output, failure)
            except OSError:
                pass
        print(json.dumps(failure), file=sys.stderr)
        return 2


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())

def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:

def package_check():
    for name in REQUIRED:
        p = ROOT / name
        require(p.is_file() and p.resolve().is_relative_to(ROOT), 'Missing/escaping resource: ' + name)
    for folder in ('references', 'templates', 'scripts'):
        for p in (ROOT / folder).rglob('*'):
            if p.suffix == '.py':
                compile(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'), str(p), 'exec')
    # README includes repository-facing installation links; bundled resources
    # and entry point must resolve inside the independently installed skill.
    for p in [ROOT / 'SKILL.md', *(ROOT / 'references').glob('*.md'), *(ROOT / 'templates').glob('*.md')]:
        for target in re.findall(r'\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)', p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')):
            if target.startswith('#') or re.match(r'[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*:', target):
                continue
            linked = (p.parent / target.split('#')[0]).resolve()
            require(linked.is_relative_to(ROOT) and linked.is_file(), 'Broken/escaping link: ' + target)
    text = (ROOT / 'SKILL.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    require(re.search(r'^name: research-writer$', text, re.M), 'Skill discovery name differs')
    entries = json.loads((ROOT / 'references/tool-catalog.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    engines = entries.get('engines') if isinstance(entries, dict) else None
    require(isinstance(engines, list) and len(engines) == 14, 'Incomplete engine catalog')
    upstream = ROOT / 'references' / 'upstream'
    manifest = json.loads((upstream / 'manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    required_sources = {'humanizer.md', 'humanizer-license.md',
                        'storyscope-taxonomy.json', 'storyscope-license.md'}
    resources = manifest.get('resources', [])
    require(len(resources) == 4 and {r.get('path') for r in resources} == required_sources,
            'Incomplete writing-source manifest')
    for resource in resources:
        data = (upstream / resource['path']).read_bytes()
        require(hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == resource.get('sha256'),
                'Writing-source hash mismatch: ' + resource['path'])
        blob = b'blob ' + str(len(data)).encode() + b'\0' + data
        require(hashlib.sha1(blob).hexdigest() == resource.get('git_blob_sha1'),
                'Writing-source Git identity mismatch: ' + resource['path'])

                'Unexpected writing-source provenance: ' + resource['path'])

    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ROOT / 'scripts' / script), *map(str, arguments)],

                            env={**os.environ, 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE': '1'})
    require(result.returncode == expected,

    return result

                checks.append({'name': 'protein', 'status': 'skipped', 'reason': 'not requested'})
    except Exception as exc:
        print(json.dumps({'passed': False, 'checks': checks, 'error': f'{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}'}))

    print(json.dumps({'passed': True, 'checks': checks, 'scope': 'offline installation/control checks; no scientific validation'}))

        raise ValueError('Pinned submission host/user mismatch')

        raise ValueError('Exact native Slurm command mapping required')

            child=subprocess.Popen([p['commands'][name],*args],stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                                   stdout=stdout,stderr=stderr,shell=False,start_new_session=True)
            end=time.monotonic()+20

                while child.poll() is None:
                    if time.monotonic()>end or out.stat().st_size>1024*1024 or err.stat().st_size>65536:
                        raise ValueError('Scheduler reply timeout/size limit; mutation outcome may be uncertain')

def descriptor(value):
    if not isinstance(value,dict) or set(value) != {'schema_version','backup_id','size','sha256','logical_sha256'}:
        raise ValueError('Exact backup descriptor fields required')
    if type(value['schema_version']) is not int or value['schema_version'] not in (1,2):
        raise ValueError('Unknown backup descriptor version')
    C.identifier(value['backup_id']); C.sha(value['sha256']); C.sha(value['logical_sha256'])
    if type(value['size']) is not int or not 1 <= value['size'] <= (B.MAX_BACKUP if value['schema_version']==1 else MAX_BACKUP):
        raise ValueError('Backup size outside absolute bound')
    return value


def write_all(stream, raw):
    view = memoryview(raw)
    while view:
        count = stream.write(view)
        if type(count) is not int or not 0 < count <= len(view): raise OSError('Short or invalid stream write')
        view = view[count:]


def exact(stream, size):
    out = bytearray()
    while len(out) < size:
        raw = stream.read(size-len(out))
        if not raw: raise ValueError('Truncated frame header')
        out.extend(raw)
    return bytes(out)


def read_header(stream, maximum=MAX_BACKUP):
    magic, size, count = PREFIX.unpack(exact(stream, PREFIX.size))
    if magic != MAGIC or not 1 <= size <= MAX_SMALL or count > maximum:
        raise ValueError('Frame magic/header/body bound mismatch')
    meta = decode(exact(stream,size))
    if not isinstance(meta,dict): raise ValueError('Frame metadata must be an object')
    return meta, count


def eof(stream):
    if stream.read(1): raise ValueError('Trailing bytes after frame')


def copy_body(source, target, count, chunk_bytes, expected=None):
    chunk(chunk_bytes)
    h = hashlib.sha256(); remaining = count
    while remaining:
        raw = source.read(min(remaining,chunk_bytes))
        if not raw: raise ValueError('Truncated frame body')
        if len(raw) > min(remaining,chunk_bytes): raise ValueError('Reader exceeded requested bound')
        write_all(target,raw); h.update(raw); remaining -= len(raw)
    if expected is not None and h.hexdigest() != expected: raise ValueError('Transfer checksum mismatch')
    return h.hexdigest()


def write_header(stream, meta, count):
    raw = canonical(meta)
    if len(raw)>MAX_SMALL or type(count) is not int or not 0<=count<=MAX_BACKUP:
        raise ValueError('Frame exceeds bound')
    write_all(stream,PREFIX.pack(MAGIC,len(raw),count)); write_all(stream,raw)


from contextlib import contextmanager
@contextmanager
def artifact_stream(path, maximum):
    path = C.no_symlinks(path); before = path.lstat()
    if not stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) or before.st_nlink != 1 or not 1 <= before.st_size <= maximum:
        raise ValueError('Bounded regular non-hardlinked database required')
    fd = os.open(path,os.O_RDONLY|getattr(os,'O_NOFOLLOW',0)|getattr(os,'O_NONBLOCK',0))
    try:
        actual = os.fstat(fd)
        identity = lambda x:(x.st_dev,x.st_ino,x.st_size)
        if identity(before) != identity(actual) or not stat.S_ISREG(actual.st_mode) or actual.st_nlink != 1:
            raise ValueError('Database changed during open')
        with os.fdopen(fd,'rb',closefd=False) as stream:
            yield stream,actual.st_size
        after = os.fstat(fd); current = path.lstat()
        fields = lambda x:(x.st_dev,x.st_ino,x.st_size,x.st_mtime_ns,x.st_ctime_ns,x.st_nlink)
        # Path stat and descriptor stat can expose different timestamp
        # representations. Detect mutation within each API and compare stable
        # file identity/size across APIs, retaining both replacement guards.
        if fields(actual)!=fields(after) or fields(before)!=fields(current) or identity(after)!=identity(current):
            raise ValueError('Database changed during read')
    finally: os.close(fd)


@contextmanager
def private_sink(path):
    fd=os.open(path,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|getattr(os,'O_NOFOLLOW',0),0o600)
    with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as stream:
        yield stream


def hash_file(path, maximum, chunk_bytes):
    chunk(chunk_bytes)
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with artifact_stream(path,maximum) as (stream,size):
        remaining = size
        while remaining:
            raw=stream.read(min(remaining,chunk_bytes))
            if not raw: raise ValueError('Database truncated')
            h.update(raw); remaining-=len(raw)
        eof(stream)
    return size,h.hexdigest()


def checked_artifact(store, d, maximum, chunk_bytes):
    descriptor(d)
    if d['size']>cap(maximum): raise ValueError('Backup exceeds selected cap')
    path=Path(store)/C.DB_NAME
    if hash_file(path,maximum,chunk_bytes)!=(d['size'],d['sha256']): raise ValueError('Backup bytes do not match immutable intent')
    drill=B.drill_store(store)
    if drill['logical_sha256']!=d['logical_sha256']: raise ValueError('Logical inventory mismatch')
    if hash_file(path,maximum,chunk_bytes)!=(d['size'],d['sha256']): raise ValueError('Backup changed during verification')
    return drill


def pins(p):
    return {k:p[k] for k in ('remote_root','vault_id','expected_hostname','expected_user')}


def make_intent(p,d,lineage=None):
    value={'schema_version':2,'profile_sha256':C.digest(canonical(p)),'profile':p,
           'destination':pins(p),'descriptor':d,'lineage':lineage}
    if len(canonical(value))>MAX_SMALL: raise ValueError('Intent exceeds metadata bound')
    return value


def prepare(p,store,backup_id,state_dir):
    p=profile(p); C.identifier(backup_id); destination=new_parent(state_dir); source=C.no_symlinks(store)
    if destination==source or source in destination.parents or destination in source.parents: raise ValueError('State must be separate from source')
    stage=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='.rw-stream-prepare-',dir=destination.parent))
    try:
        C.backup(source,stage/'snapshot',True,max_backup_bytes=p['max_backup_bytes'])
        size,digest=hash_file(stage/'snapshot'/C.DB_NAME,p['max_backup_bytes'],p['chunk_bytes'])
        drill=B.drill_store(stage/'snapshot')
        if hash_file(stage/'snapshot'/C.DB_NAME,p['max_backup_bytes'],p['chunk_bytes'])!=(size,digest):
            raise ValueError('Prepared database changed during drill')
        d=descriptor({'schema_version':2,'backup_id':backup_id,'size':size,'sha256':digest,'logical_sha256':drill['logical_sha256']})
        fsync_file(stage/'snapshot'/C.DB_NAME)
        write_new(stage/'intent.json',canonical(make_intent(p,d))); C.fsync_directory(stage)
        C.rename_new(stage,destination); C.fsync_directory(destination.parent)
        return result('prepared',d,drill)
    finally:
        if stage.exists(): shutil.rmtree(stage)


def load_intent(p,state_dir,historical=False):
    p=profile(p,historical=historical); root=private_directory(state_dir)
    entries=list(root.iterdir())
    if {x.name for x in entries}-{'intent.json','snapshot','attempt.json','upload-block.json'}: raise ValueError('Unexpected state entry')
    if any(x.is_symlink() for x in entries): raise ValueError('Symlink state entry forbidden')
    value=decode(C.regular(root/'intent.json',MAX_SMALL))
    if not isinstance(value,dict) or type(value.get('schema_version')) is not int: raise ValueError('Invalid intent')
    if value['schema_version']==1:
        if set(value)!={'schema_version','profile_sha256','descriptor'} or p['schema_version']!=1: raise ValueError('Invalid legacy intent')
    elif value['schema_version']==2:
        if set(value)!={'schema_version','profile_sha256','profile','destination','descriptor','lineage'}: raise ValueError('Invalid stream intent')
        if value['profile']!=p or value['destination']!=pins(p): raise ValueError('Saved profile/destination mismatch')
        lineage=value['lineage']
        if lineage is not None:
            if not isinstance(lineage,dict) or set(lineage)!={'old_intent_sha256','old_profile_sha256','new_profile_sha256'}: raise ValueError('Invalid lineage')
            for digest in lineage.values(): C.sha(digest)
            if lineage['new_profile_sha256']!=C.digest(canonical(p)): raise ValueError('Invalid new profile lineage')
            block=decode(C.regular(root/'upload-block.json',MAX_SMALL))
            if block!={'schema_version':2,'upload_permanently_blocked':True,'lineage':lineage}: raise ValueError('Missing permanent migration block')
    else: raise ValueError('Unknown intent version')
    if value['profile_sha256']!=C.digest(canonical(p)): raise ValueError('Profile changed since preparation')
    d=descriptor(value['descriptor'])
    if d['size']>p['max_backup_bytes']: raise ValueError('Intent exceeds selected cap')
    return root,d


def request(p,operation,d=None):
    return {'schema_version':2,'operation':operation,**pins(p),'max_backup_bytes':p['max_backup_bytes'],
            'chunk_bytes':p['chunk_bytes'],'descriptor':d}


def rpc(p,req,upload=None,download=None):
    """Single SSH process, regular file stdio, bounded buffers; disk O(artifact)."""
    sources={name:C.regular(ROOT/file,MAX_SMALL).decode() for name,file in
             [('checkpoint_source','checkpoint_tools.py'),('backup_source','backup_tools.py'),('stream_source','stream_backup_tools.py')]}
    bootstrap=canonical(sources)
    if len(bootstrap)>MAX_SMALL: raise ValueError('Bootstrap exceeds bound')
    argv=R.ssh_argv(p); argv[-1]=shlex.join([p['remote_python'],'-c',BOOTSTRAP])
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='rw-stream-rpc-') as directory:
        folder=Path(directory).resolve(); inp,out,err=[folder/n for n in ('input','output','error')]
        with inp.open('xb') as target:
            write_all(target,struct.pack('!I',len(bootstrap))); write_all(target,bootstrap)
            d=req['descriptor']; count=d['size'] if upload is not None else 0
            write_header(target,req,count)
            if upload is not None:
                with artifact_stream(upload,p['max_backup_bytes']) as (source,size):
                    if size!=count: raise ValueError('Upload length changed')
                    copy_body(source,target,count,p['chunk_bytes'],d['sha256']); eof(source)
            target.flush(); os.fsync(target.fileno())
        with inp.open('rb') as source,out.open('xb') as stdout,err.open('xb') as stderr:
            child=subprocess.Popen(argv,stdin=source,stdout=stdout,stderr=stderr,shell=False,start_new_session=os.name=='posix')
            deadline=time.monotonic()+p['rpc_timeout_seconds']; reason=None
            try:
                while child.poll() is None:
                    if time.monotonic()>deadline: reason='SSH deadline; outcome uncertain'; break
                    if out.stat().st_size>p['max_backup_bytes']+MAX_SMALL+PREFIX.size or err.stat().st_size>MAX_SMALL:
                        reason='SSH output limit; outcome uncertain'; break
                    time.sleep(.025)
                if reason: raise R.TransportError(reason)
                child.wait()
            finally:
                if child.poll() is None:
                    if os.name=='posix':
                        try: os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
                        except ProcessLookupError: pass
                    else: child.kill()
                    child.wait(timeout=5)
        if out.stat().st_size>p['max_backup_bytes']+MAX_SMALL+PREFIX.size or err.stat().st_size>MAX_SMALL:
            raise R.TransportError('SSH output limit; outcome uncertain')
        if child.returncode: raise R.TransportError('SSH failed; outcome uncertain: '+C.regular(err,MAX_SMALL).decode('utf-8','replace')[-1000:])
        with out.open('rb') as source:
            reply,count=read_header(source,p['max_backup_bytes'])
            fields={'schema_version','hostname','user','remote_root','vault_id','ok','receipt'}
            if set(reply)!=fields or type(reply['schema_version']) is not int or reply['schema_version']!=2 or type(reply['ok']) is not bool or reply['hostname']!=p['expected_hostname'] or reply['user']!=p['expected_user'] or reply['remote_root']!=p['remote_root'] or reply['vault_id']!=p['vault_id']:
                raise R.TransportError('Receiver identity/protocol mismatch; outcome uncertain')
            receipt=reply['receipt']
            if not isinstance(receipt,dict): raise ValueError('Invalid receipt')
            if not reply['ok']:
                if count: raise ValueError('Failure response has body')
                eof(source); raise ValueError('Receiver rejected: '+str(receipt.get('error','unknown'))[:1000])
            expected=d['size'] if req['operation']=='get' else 0
            if count!=expected or (d is not None and receipt.get('descriptor')!=d): raise ValueError('Readback descriptor/length mismatch')
            if count:
                if download is None: raise ValueError('Missing readback sink')
                with private_sink(download) as target:
                    copy_body(source,target,count,p['chunk_bytes'],d['sha256']); eof(source)
                    target.flush(); os.fsync(target.fileno())
            else: eof(source)
        return receipt


def init_remote(p,allow_transfer=False):
    p=profile(p)
    if not allow_transfer: raise ValueError('Explicit --allow-transfer required')
    rpc(p,request(p,'init')); return {**result('vault_ready'),'vault_id':p['vault_id']}


def push(p,state_dir,allow_transfer=False):
    p=profile(p)
    if not allow_transfer: raise ValueError('Explicit --allow-transfer required')
    root,d=load_intent(p,state_dir)
    if (root/'upload-block.json').exists(): raise ValueError('Migrated state permanently blocks upload; verify/fetch only')
    if (root/'attempt.json').exists(): raise ValueError('Upload already attempted; use read-only verify/fetch')
    checked_artifact(root/'snapshot',d,p['max_backup_bytes'],p['chunk_bytes'])
    write_new(root/'attempt.json',canonical({'schema_version':2,'descriptor':d})); C.fsync_directory(root)
    try:
        rpc(p,request(p,'put',d),upload=root/'snapshot'/C.DB_NAME)
        return verify(p,root)
    except Exception as exc: raise R.TransportError('Backup outcome uncertain; reconcile with verify/fetch: '+str(exc)[:1000]) from exc


def receive(p,d,destination):
    destination=new_parent(destination); stage=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='.rw-stream-fetch-',dir=destination.parent))
    try:
        rpc(p,request(p,'get',d),download=stage/C.DB_NAME)
        drill=checked_artifact(stage,d,p['max_backup_bytes'],p['chunk_bytes'])
        fsync_file(stage/C.DB_NAME); C.fsync_directory(stage)
        C.rename_new(stage,destination); C.fsync_directory(destination.parent)
        return drill
    finally:
        if stage.exists(): shutil.rmtree(stage)


def verify(p,state_dir):
    p=profile(p); root,d=load_intent(p,state_dir)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='rw-stream-readback-') as directory:
        drill=receive(p,d,Path(directory).resolve()/'store')
    return result('verified',d,{**drill,'fresh_ssh_readback':True})


def fetch(p,state_dir,destination,allow_restore=False):
    p=profile(p)
    if not allow_restore: raise ValueError('Explicit --allow-restore required')
    root,d=load_intent(p,state_dir); destination=new_parent(destination)
    if destination==root or root in destination.parents or destination in root.parents: raise ValueError('Fetch destination must be separate from state')
    drill=receive(p,d,destination)
    return {**result('fetched',d,{**drill,'fresh_ssh_readback':True}),'destination':str(destination)}


def migrate_profile(source_profile,p,state_dir,destination,allow_migrate=False):
    if not allow_migrate: raise ValueError('Explicit --allow-migrate required')
    old=profile(source_profile,historical=True); p=profile(p)
    root,d=load_intent(old,state_dir,historical=True); destination=new_parent(destination)
    if destination==root or root in destination.parents or destination in root.parents: raise ValueError('Migration destination must be separate from old state')
    if pins(old)!=pins(p): raise ValueError('Migration cannot change host/user/root/vault destination pins')
    if d['size']>p['max_backup_bytes']: raise ValueError('New cap cannot fit artifact')
    # A retained snapshot is checked; the immutable intent also supports
    # recovery after source/staging loss, with fresh remote bytes as authority.
    if (root/'snapshot').exists():
        checked_artifact(root/'snapshot',d,old['max_backup_bytes'],old.get('chunk_bytes',MIN_CHUNK))
    old_intent=C.regular(root/'intent.json',MAX_SMALL)
    stage=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='.rw-stream-migrate-',dir=destination.parent))
    try:
        drill=receive(p,d,stage/'snapshot')
        lineage={'old_intent_sha256':C.digest(old_intent),'old_profile_sha256':C.digest(canonical(old)),
                 'new_profile_sha256':C.digest(canonical(p))}
        write_new(stage/'intent.json',canonical(make_intent(p,d,lineage)))
        write_new(stage/'upload-block.json',canonical({'schema_version':2,'upload_permanently_blocked':True,'lineage':lineage}))
        if (root/'attempt.json').exists(): write_new(stage/'attempt.json',C.regular(root/'attempt.json',MAX_SMALL))
        C.fsync_directory(stage); C.rename_new(stage,destination); C.fsync_directory(destination.parent)
        return {**result('profile_migrated_read_only',d,{**drill,'fresh_ssh_readback':True}),'lineage':lineage,'upload_permanently_blocked':True,'destination':str(destination)}
    finally:
        if stage.exists(): shutil.rmtree(stage)


def read_archive(root,d,maximum,chunk_bytes):
    target=private_directory(root/'backups'/d['backup_id'])
    if {x.name for x in target.iterdir()}!={'descriptor.json','store'}: raise ValueError('Unexpected archive entry')
    if decode(C.regular(target/'descriptor.json',MAX_SMALL))!=d: raise ValueError('Immutable ID has different descriptor')
    drill=checked_artifact(target/'store',d,maximum,chunk_bytes)
    return target/'store'/C.DB_NAME,drill


def receiver(req,count,source):
    if os.name!='posix': raise ValueError('Receiver requires POSIX filesystem')
    fields={'schema_version','operation','remote_root','vault_id','expected_hostname','expected_user','max_backup_bytes','chunk_bytes','descriptor'}
    if set(req)!=fields or type(req['schema_version']) is not int or req['schema_version']!=2 or req['operation'] not in ('init','put','get'): raise ValueError('Invalid stream request')
    if req['expected_hostname']!=socket.gethostname() or req['expected_user']!=getpass.getuser(): raise ValueError('Receiver host/user mismatch')
    maximum=cap(req['max_backup_bytes']); chunk_bytes=chunk(req['chunk_bytes']); C.identifier(req['vault_id'])
    name=req['remote_root']
    if not isinstance(name,str) or not PurePosixPath(name).is_absolute() or '..' in PurePosixPath(name).parts or str(PurePosixPath(name))!=name or len(PurePosixPath(name).parts)<3: raise ValueError('Absolute dedicated vault root required')
    root=C.outside_skill(name)
    if any((p/'SKILL.md').is_file() for p in (root,*root.parents)): raise ValueError('Remote vault must be outside skill folders')
    if req['operation']=='init':
        if req['descriptor'] is not None or count: raise ValueError('Invalid init payload')
        eof(source); return B.init_vault(root,req['vault_id']),None
    d=descriptor(req['descriptor'])
    if d['size']>maximum or count!=(d['size'] if req['operation']=='put' else 0): raise ValueError('Payload length/cap mismatch')
    with B.vault_lock(root):
        B.vault(root,req['vault_id'])
        if req['operation']=='get':
            eof(source); path,drill=read_archive(root,d,maximum,chunk_bytes)
            return result('verified',d,drill),path
        stage=root/('.stage-'+uuid.uuid4().hex); stage.mkdir(mode=0o700)
        try:
            (stage/'store').mkdir(mode=0o700)
            with private_sink(stage/'store'/C.DB_NAME) as target:
                copy_body(source,target,count,chunk_bytes,d['sha256']); eof(source)
                target.flush(); os.fsync(target.fileno())
            drill=checked_artifact(stage/'store',d,maximum,chunk_bytes)
            destination=root/'backups'/d['backup_id']
            if destination.exists():
                read_archive(root,d,maximum,chunk_bytes)
                return result('already_present',d,drill),None
            write_new(stage/'descriptor.json',canonical(d)); fsync_file(stage/'store'/C.DB_NAME)
            C.fsync_directory(stage/'store'); C.fsync_directory(stage)
            C.rename_new(stage,destination)
            C.fsync_directory(root/'backups'); C.fsync_directory(root)
            return result('stored',d,drill),None
        finally:
            if stage.exists(): shutil.rmtree(stage)


def receiver_main(source=None,target=None):
    source=source or sys.stdin.buffer; target=target or sys.stdout.buffer
    req={}; path=None
    try:
        req,count=read_header(source)
        receipt,path=receiver(req,count,source); ok=True
    except Exception as exc:
        receipt={'state':'failed_or_uncertain','error':str(exc)[:1500],'execution_clearance':'not_granted'}; ok=False
    identity={'schema_version':2,'hostname':socket.gethostname(),'user':getpass.getuser(),
              'remote_root':req.get('remote_root'),'vault_id':req.get('vault_id'),'ok':ok,'receipt':receipt}
    # Once output starts, errors propagate: never append a second valid-looking frame.
    count=receipt['descriptor']['size'] if path is not None else 0
    write_header(target,identity,count)
    if path is not None:
        with artifact_stream(path,req['max_backup_bytes']) as (stream,size):
            if size!=count: raise ValueError('Readback length changed')
            copy_body(stream,target,count,req['chunk_bytes'],receipt['descriptor']['sha256']); eof(stream)
    target.flush()


def main(argv=None):
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__); sub=parser.add_subparsers(dest='operation',required=True)
    for op in ('init-remote','prepare','push','verify','fetch','migrate-profile'):
        cmd=sub.add_parser(op); cmd.add_argument('--profile',required=True); cmd.add_argument('--report',required=True)
        if op!='init-remote': cmd.add_argument('--state-dir',required=True)
        if op=='prepare': cmd.add_argument('--store',required=True); cmd.add_argument('--backup-id',required=True)
        if op in ('init-remote','push'): cmd.add_argument('--allow-transfer',action='store_true')
        if op=='fetch': cmd.add_argument('--destination',required=True); cmd.add_argument('--allow-restore',action='store_true')
        if op=='migrate-profile':
            cmd.add_argument('--source-profile',required=True); cmd.add_argument('--destination',required=True); cmd.add_argument('--allow-migrate',action='store_true')
    args=parser.parse_args(argv); report=None; safe=False
    try:
        report=C.outside_skill(args.report)
        if report.exists(): raise ValueError('Report must be new')
        private_directory(report.parent)
        for name in ('store','state_dir','destination'):
            if getattr(args,name,None) is not None:
                protected=C.no_symlinks(getattr(args,name))
                if report==protected or protected in report.parents: raise ValueError('Report must be separate from source/state/destination')
        safe=True; p=profile(decode(C.regular(args.profile,MAX_SMALL)))
        if args.operation=='init-remote': reply=init_remote(p,args.allow_transfer)
        elif args.operation=='prepare': reply=prepare(p,args.store,args.backup_id,args.state_dir)
        elif args.operation=='push': reply=push(p,args.state_dir,args.allow_transfer)
        elif args.operation=='verify': reply=verify(p,args.state_dir)
        elif args.operation=='fetch': reply=fetch(p,args.state_dir,args.destination,args.allow_restore)
        else: reply=migrate_profile(decode(C.regular(args.source_profile,MAX_SMALL)),p,args.state_dir,args.destination,args.allow_migrate)
        B.publish_report(report,canonical({'schema_version':2,'ok':True,**reply})+b'\n'); return 0
    except Exception as exc:
        reply={'schema_version':2,'ok':False,'state':'failed_or_uncertain','error':str(exc)[:1500],'execution_clearance':'not_granted'}
        try:
            if safe and report is not None and not report.exists(): write_new(report,canonical(reply)+b'\n')
        except Exception: pass
        print(canonical(reply).decode(),file=sys.stderr); return 2


if __name__=='__main__': raise SystemExit(main())
